```{r}
      freq_table <- table(non_na)
      if(any(freq_table < 5)) {
        separation_vars <- c(separation_vars, var)
        cat("  ⚠️  Sparse levels:", var, 
            "(min count =", min(freq_table), ")\n")
      }
    }
  }
}

if(length(separation_vars) == 0) {
  cat("  ✓ No separation issues detected\n")
}
cat("\n")

# B4. SPECIAL HANDLING FOR DERIVED VARIABLES
cat("B4. Handling derived/composite variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# n_health_conditions is a SUM of other condition counts
# It should NOT be imputed or used as a predictor
derived_vars <- c("n_health_conditions")

if(any(derived_vars %in% names(df_imp))) {
  cat("  ISSUE: n_health_conditions is derived (sum of component counts)\n")
  cat("         Using it as predictor creates perfect collinearity\n\n")
  cat("  Removing derived variables from imputation:\n")
  for(var in derived_vars) {
    if(var %in% names(df_imp)) {
      cat("    • ", var, " (will be recalculated post-imputation)\n", sep = "")
      df_imp <- df_imp %>% select(-all_of(var))
    }
  }
  cat("\n  ✓ Derived variables removed\n")
  cat("    Remaining variables:", ncol(df_imp), "\n\n")
  cat("  POST-IMPUTATION: n_health_conditions will be recalculated as:\n")
  cat("    n_health_conditions = n_physical_conditions + n_ment_conditions + n_sleep_conditions\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  ✓ No derived variables to remove\n\n")
}

# Compile problematic variables
problematic_vars <- unique(c(constant_vars, nzv_vars, low_n_vars, derived_vars))

if(length(problematic_vars) > length(derived_vars)) {
  cat("SUMMARY OF PROBLEMATIC VARIABLES (excluding derived):\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  non_derived_problematic <- setdiff(problematic_vars, derived_vars)
  if(length(non_derived_problematic) > 0) {
    cat("  Additional problematic:", length(non_derived_problematic), "\n")
    for(v in non_derived_problematic) {
      cat("    •", v, "\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: MULTICOLLINEARITY CHECK (VIF) - ALL ELIGIBLE VARIABLES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: MULTICOLLINEARITY CHECK (VIF)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("PURPOSE: High multicollinearity can cause imputation instability.\n")
cat("  • VIF < 5: Acceptable\n")
cat("  • VIF 5-10: Moderate concern\n")
cat("  • VIF > 10: High multicollinearity (consider removing)\n\n")

# Select numeric variables with COMPLETE data for VIF
numeric_complete <- df_imp %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(where(~sum(is.na(.)) == 0))

cat("ELIGIBLE VARIABLES FOR VIF (complete numeric only):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
if(ncol(numeric_complete) > 0) {
  for(i in 1:ncol(numeric_complete)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %2d. %s\n", i, names(numeric_complete)[i]))
  }
  cat("\nTotal eligible:", ncol(numeric_complete), "variables\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  No complete numeric variables found\n\n")
}

if(ncol(numeric_complete) >= 3) {
  cat("Calculating VIF for ALL", ncol(numeric_complete), "eligible variables...\n\n")
  
  vif_result <- tryCatch({
    # Check correlation matrix first
    cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_complete, use = "complete.obs")
    
    # Check for perfect/near-perfect correlations
    upper_tri_cor <- cor_matrix[upper.tri(cor_matrix)]
    max_cor <- max(abs(upper_tri_cor))
    
    if(max_cor > 0.99) {
      cat("  ⚠️  Perfect/near-perfect correlation detected (r =", round(max_cor, 3), ")\n")
      
      # Find which variables are perfectly correlated
      perfect_pairs <- which(abs(cor_matrix) > 0.99 & abs(cor_matrix) < 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
      if(nrow(perfect_pairs) > 0) {
        cat("     Perfectly correlated pairs:\n")
        for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(perfect_pairs))) {
          var1 <- rownames(cor_matrix)[perfect_pairs[i, 1]]
          var2 <- colnames(cor_matrix)[perfect_pairs[i, 2]]
          cat("       •", var1, "↔", var2, "\n")
        }
        if(nrow(perfect_pairs) > 5) {
          cat("       ... and", nrow(perfect_pairs) - 5, "more pairs\n")
        }
      }
      cat("     Skipping VIF due to perfect multicollinearity\n\n")
      NULL
    } else {
      # Calculate VIF using linear model approach
      vif_formula <- as.formula(paste(names(numeric_complete)[1], "~", 
                                      paste(names(numeric_complete)[-1], collapse = " + ")))
      vif_model <- lm(vif_formula, data = numeric_complete)
      car::vif(vif_model)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  ⚠️  VIF calculation failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    cat("     This indicates aliased coefficients (perfect multicollinearity)\n")
    cat("     Proceeding without VIF analysis\n\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  if(!is.null(vif_result)) {
    vif_df <- data.frame(
      variable = names(vif_result),
      VIF = as.numeric(vif_result)
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(VIF))
    
    cat("VIF RESULTS FOR ALL", nrow(vif_df), "VARIABLES:\n")
    cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
    
    # Print all VIF values
    for(i in 1:nrow(vif_df)) {
      status <- if(vif_df$VIF[i] < 5) "✓" else if(vif_df$VIF[i] < 10) "⚠️" else "✗"
      cat(sprintf("  %s %2d. %-30s: VIF = %6.2f\n",
                  status, i, vif_df$variable[i], vif_df$VIF[i]))
    }
    cat("\n")
    
    # Summary
    high_vif <- vif_df %>% filter(VIF > 10)
    mod_vif <- vif_df %>% filter(VIF >= 5 & VIF <= 10)
    low_vif <- vif_df %>% filter(VIF < 5)
    
    cat("VIF SUMMARY:\n")
    cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ Low VIF (<5):        %3d variables (%.1f%%)\n", 
                nrow(low_vif), 100*nrow(low_vif)/nrow(vif_df)))
    cat(sprintf("  ⚠️ Moderate VIF (5-10): %3d variables (%.1f%%)\n", 
                nrow(mod_vif), 100*nrow(mod_vif)/nrow(vif_df)))
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ High VIF (>10):      %3d variables (%.1f%%)\n\n", 
                nrow(high_vif), 100*nrow(high_vif)/nrow(vif_df)))
    
    if(nrow(high_vif) > 0) {
      cat("⚠️  VARIABLES WITH HIGH VIF (>10) - CONSIDER REMOVING:\n")
      for(i in 1:nrow(high_vif)) {
        cat(sprintf("  %2d. %-30s: VIF = %.2f\n", 
                    i, high_vif$variable[i], high_vif$VIF[i]))
      }
      cat("\nHigh VIF indicates these variables are highly correlated with others.\n")
      cat("Consider removing one from each correlated pair.\n\n")
    }
    
    write.csv(vif_df, "vif_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
    cat("✓ Saved: vif_analysis.csv\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("ℹ️  Not enough complete numeric variables for VIF analysis\n")
  cat("   (Need at least 3, found", ncol(numeric_complete), ")\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: DEFINE VARIABLE TYPES FOR IMPUTATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: DEFINING VARIABLE TYPES FOR IMPUTATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Get variable lists from Chunk 6
continuous_vars <- c(
  "age",
  "med_quant", "phq2_score", "osss_3_score",
  # NOTE: n_health_conditions removed - will be recalculated post-imputation
  "n_physical_conditions", "n_ment_conditions", "n_sleep_conditions",
  "wdl_symptom_count",
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$dbas)) analysis_vars$dbas else character(),
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$bfi)) analysis_vars$bfi else character(),
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$surps)) analysis_vars$surps else character(),
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$ciss)) analysis_vars$ciss else character()
)

binary_vars <- c("sex")

ordered_vars <- c(
  "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq",
  "gen_health",
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$sleep_aids)) analysis_vars$sleep_aids else character(),
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$adverse_effects)) analysis_vars$adverse_effects else character(),
  "stop_wdl_exp_combined"
)

unordered_categorical <- c(
  paste0("stop_wdl_exp___", 0:4)
)

# Filter to only variables in df_imp
continuous_vars <- continuous_vars[continuous_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
binary_vars <- binary_vars[binary_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
ordered_vars <- ordered_vars[ordered_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
unordered_categorical <- unordered_categorical[unordered_categorical %in% names(df_imp)]

cat("VARIABLE TYPE ASSIGNMENT:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Continuous (PMM):", length(continuous_vars), "variables\n")
cat("  Binary (logreg):", length(binary_vars), "variables\n")
cat("  Ordered (polr):", length(ordered_vars), "variables\n")
cat("  Unordered categorical (polyreg):", length(unordered_categorical), "variables\n")
cat("  Total:", length(continuous_vars) + length(binary_vars) + 
    length(ordered_vars) + length(unordered_categorical), "\n\n")

# Convert to proper types
cat("Converting variables to proper types...\n")

for(var in continuous_vars) {
  if(!is.numeric(df_imp[[var]])) {
    df_imp[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(df_imp[[var]]))
  }
}

for(var in binary_vars) {
  df_imp[[var]] <- as.numeric(df_imp[[var]])
}

for(var in ordered_vars) {
  if(!is.ordered(df_imp[[var]])) {
    df_imp[[var]] <- factor(df_imp[[var]], ordered = TRUE)
  }
}

for(var in unordered_categorical) {
  if(!is.factor(df_imp[[var]]) || is.ordered(df_imp[[var]])) {
    df_imp[[var]] <- factor(df_imp[[var]], ordered = FALSE)
  }
}

cat("✓ Variable type conversion complete\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: STATISTICAL DERIVATION OF MAXIT
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: STATISTICAL DERIVATION OF MAXIT\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("PURPOSE: Determine iterations needed for convergence.\n")
cat("  • Maxit too low: Imputation hasn't converged (biased estimates)\n")
cat("  • Maxit too high: Unnecessary computation time\n\n")

cat("METHOD: Test small sample imputation to estimate convergence rate\n\n")

# Initialize MICE to get methods
init <- mice(df_imp, maxit = 0, print = FALSE)
method <- init$method
pred <- init$predictorMatrix

# Set methods
for(var in continuous_vars) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing) {
    method[var] <- "pmm"
  }
}
for(var in binary_vars) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing) {
    method[var] <- "logreg"
  }
}
for(var in ordered_vars) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing) {
    method[var] <- "polr"
  }
}
for(var in unordered_categorical) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing) {
    method[var] <- "polyreg"
  }
}

# Remove methods for problematic variables
if(length(problematic_vars) > 0) {
  for(var in problematic_vars) {
    if(var %in% names(method)) {
      method[var] <- ""
    }
  }
}

cat("METHOD SUMMARY:\n")
cat("  PMM:", sum(method == "pmm"), "\n")
cat("  Logreg:", sum(method == "logreg"), "\n")
cat("  Polr:", sum(method == "polr"), "\n")
cat("  Polyreg:", sum(method == "polyreg"), "\n")
cat("  Not imputed:", sum(method == ""), "\n\n")

# Run quick test imputation to check convergence characteristics
cat("Running test imputation to assess convergence...\n")

test_imp <- tryCatch({
  mice(df_imp, m = 2, maxit = 20, method = method, predictorMatrix = pred, 
       seed = 12345, printFlag = FALSE)
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("  ⚠️  Test imputation failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  NULL
})

if(!is.null(test_imp)) {
  # Check for convergence issues in logged events
  if(nrow(test_imp$loggedEvents) > 0) {
    n_convergence_issues <- sum(grepl("convergence|collinearity", 
                                      test_imp$loggedEvents$out, 
                                      ignore.case = TRUE))
    if(n_convergence_issues > 0) {
      cat("  ⚠️", n_convergence_issues, "convergence warnings detected\n")
      cat("     → Recommending higher maxit\n")
      convergence_penalty <- 10
    } else {
      cat("  ✓ No convergence warnings\n")
      convergence_penalty <- 0
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ✓ Test imputation completed without warnings\n")
    convergence_penalty <- 0
  }
  
  # Assess based on data characteristics
  n_vars_to_impute <- sum(method != "")
  avg_missingness <- mean(missing_pct[missing_pct > 0])
  
  cat("\nCONVERGENCE ASSESSMENT:\n")
  cat("  Variables to impute:", n_vars_to_impute, "\n")
  cat("  Average missingness:", round(avg_missingness, 1), "%\n")
  cat("  Complexity score:", round(n_vars_to_impute * avg_missingness / 100, 1), "\n\n")
  
  # Calculate optimal maxit based on data characteristics
  base_maxit <- 20
  complexity_adjustment <- ceiling(n_vars_to_impute / 10) + ceiling(avg_missingness / 2)
  
  optimal_maxit <- base_maxit + complexity_adjustment + convergence_penalty
  
  # Cap at reasonable maximum
  if(optimal_maxit > 50) {
    cat("  Initial calculation:", optimal_maxit, "(capped at 50)\n")
    optimal_maxit <- 50
  }
  
  cat("MAXIT CALCULATION:\n")
  cat("  Base iterations:", base_maxit, "\n")
  cat("  Complexity adjustment:", complexity_adjustment, 
      "(based on", n_vars_to_impute, "variables,", round(avg_missingness, 1), "% missing)\n")
  if(convergence_penalty > 0) {
    cat("  Convergence penalty:", convergence_penalty, "(warnings detected)\n")
  }
  cat("  → SELECTED maxit =", optimal_maxit, "\n\n")
  
  cat("JUSTIFICATION:\n")
  cat("  ", optimal_maxit, "iterations should allow adequate convergence given:\n")
  cat("    • ", n_vars_to_impute, " variables need imputation\n", sep = "")
  cat("    • ", round(avg_missingness, 1), "% average missingness\n", sep = "")
  if(convergence_penalty > 0) {
    cat("    • Convergence issues detected in test run\n")
  }
  cat("  Post-imputation trace plots will confirm convergence\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("  Using default maxit = 30 (test imputation failed)\n\n")
  optimal_maxit <- 30
  convergence_penalty <- 0
  complexity_adjustment <- 10
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: SAVE OPTIMIZATION RESULTS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: SAVING OPTIMIZATION RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Save optimized imputation dataset
saveRDS(df_imp, "df_imputation_ready.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: df_imputation_ready.rds\n")

# Save optimal parameters
imputation_parameters <- list(
  optimal_m = optimal_m,
  optimal_m_justification = paste0(
    "Based on max missingness (", round(max_miss_pct, 1), "%). ",
    "White et al. (2011): m ≥ % missing. ",
    "Min 20 (Von Hippel, 2020)."
  ),
  optimal_maxit = optimal_maxit,
  optimal_maxit_justification = paste0(
    "Derived from: base (20) + complexity (", 
    complexity_adjustment,
    ") + penalties (", 
    convergence_penalty,
    "). Based on ", sum(method != ""), " variables, ",
    round(mean(missing_pct[missing_pct > 0]), 1), "% avg missingness."
  ),
  method = method,
  predictor_matrix = pred,
  variable_types = list(
    continuous = continuous_vars,
    binary = binary_vars,
    ordered = ordered_vars,
    unordered = unordered_categorical
  ),
  excluded_variables = c(outcome, problematic_vars),
  derived_variables_to_recalculate = derived_vars,
  n_observations = nrow(df_imp),
  n_variables = ncol(df_imp),
  n_vars_to_impute = sum(method != ""),
  max_missingness_pct = max_miss_pct,
  avg_missingness_pct = mean(missing_pct[missing_pct > 0]),
  reverse_coding_done = list(
    bfi = analysis_vars$bfi_reversed,
    surps = analysis_vars$surps_reversed
  )
)

saveRDS(imputation_parameters, "imputation_parameters_optimized.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: imputation_parameters_optimized.rds\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART G: FINAL SUMMARY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DIAGNOSTICS COMPLETE - SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("STATISTICALLY-DERIVED PARAMETERS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  • m =", optimal_m, "(based on", round(max_miss_pct, 1), "% max missingness)\n")
cat("  • maxit =", optimal_maxit, "(based on complexity assessment)\n")
cat("  • Variables to impute:", sum(method != ""), "\n")
cat("  • Observations:", nrow(df_imp), "\n\n")

cat("VARIABLE BREAKDOWN:\n")
cat("  • Continuous (PMM):", sum(method == "pmm"), "\n")
cat("  • Binary (logreg):", sum(method == "logreg"), "\n")
cat("  • Ordered (polr):", sum(method == "polr"), "\n")
cat("  • Unordered (polyreg):", sum(method == "polyreg"), "\n")
cat("  • Not imputed:", sum(method == ""), "\n\n")

if(length(problematic_vars) > 0) {
  cat("EXCLUDED VARIABLES:\n")
  cat("  • Problematic:", length(setdiff(problematic_vars, derived_vars)), "\n")
  cat("  • Derived (to recalculate):", length(derived_vars), "\n")
  for(v in derived_vars) {
    cat("    - ", v, "\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("  • Outcome:", outcome, "\n\n")
}

cat("REVERSE CODING STATUS:\n")
cat("  • BFI items already reversed in Chunk 6:", length(analysis_vars$bfi_reversed), "\n")
cat("  • SURPS items already reversed in Chunk 6:", length(analysis_vars$surps_reversed), "\n")
cat("  • NO additional reverse coding needed in Chunk 8\n\n")

cat("FILES CREATED:\n")
cat("  1. df_imputation_ready.rds - Dataset ready for imputation\n")
cat("  2. imputation_parameters_optimized.rds - Statistically-derived parameters\n")
cat("  3. pre_imputation_missingness_summary.csv - Detailed missingness\n")
if(file.exists("vif_analysis.csv")) {
  cat("  4. vif_analysis.csv - Multicollinearity assessment (ALL eligible variables)\n")
}
cat("\n")

cat("NEXT STEP: Proceed to Chunk 8 (Multiple Imputation)\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("✓ PRE-IMPUTATION DIAGNOSTICS COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
```



## Multiple Imputation
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 8: MULTIPLE IMPUTATION
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Perform multiple imputation using MICE with optimized parameters
# Outputs: Imputed datasets with convergence diagnostics
#==============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MULTIPLE IMPUTATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load optimized parameters from Chunk 7
if(!file.exists("df_imputation_ready.rds") || !file.exists("imputation_parameters_optimized.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Required files not found. Please run Chunk 7 first.")
}

df_imp <- readRDS("df_imputation_ready.rds")
imp_params <- readRDS("imputation_parameters_optimized.rds")

cat("✓ Loaded imputation-ready dataset\n")
cat("  Dimensions:", nrow(df_imp), "rows ×", ncol(df_imp), "columns\n\n")

cat("✓ Loaded optimized parameters\n")
cat("  m =", imp_params$optimal_m, "\n")
cat("  maxit =", imp_params$optimal_maxit, "\n")
cat("  Variables to impute:", imp_params$n_vars_to_impute, "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART A: RUNNING MULTIPLE IMPUTATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART A: RUNNING MULTIPLE IMPUTATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("IMPUTATION PARAMETERS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Number of imputations (m):", imp_params$optimal_m, "\n")
cat("  Iterations (maxit):", imp_params$optimal_maxit, "\n")
cat("  Variables to impute:", imp_params$n_vars_to_impute, "\n")
cat("  Imputation methods:\n")
cat("    • PMM:", sum(imp_params$method == "pmm"), "variables\n")
cat("    • Logreg:", sum(imp_params$method == "logreg"), "variables\n")
cat("    • Polr:", sum(imp_params$method == "polr"), "variables\n")
cat("    • Polyreg:", sum(imp_params$method == "polyreg"), "variables\n\n")

cat("JUSTIFICATION:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  m:", imp_params$optimal_m_justification, "\n\n")
cat("  maxit:", imp_params$optimal_maxit_justification, "\n\n")

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(12345)

cat("Starting imputation...\n")
cat("This may take several minutes...\n\n")

start_time <- Sys.time()

# Run MICE
imp_final <- mice(
  data = df_imp,
  m = imp_params$optimal_m,
  maxit = imp_params$optimal_maxit,
  method = imp_params$method,
  predictorMatrix = imp_params$predictor_matrix,
  seed = 12345,
  printFlag = TRUE
)

end_time <- Sys.time()
elapsed_time <- difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins")

cat("\n")
cat("✓ Imputation complete!\n")
cat("  Time elapsed:", round(as.numeric(elapsed_time), 2), "minutes\n\n")

# Check for convergence issues
if(nrow(imp_final$loggedEvents) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  LOGGED EVENTS DURING IMPUTATION:\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat("  Total events:", nrow(imp_final$loggedEvents), "\n")
  
  # Summarize by type
  event_summary <- table(imp_final$loggedEvents$out)
  cat("\n  Event types:\n")
  for(event in names(event_summary)) {
    cat("    •", event, ":", event_summary[event], "times\n")
  }
  
  # Show first few events
  cat("\n  First 10 events:\n")
  print(head(imp_final$loggedEvents, 10))
  cat("\n")
  
  # Save logged events
  write.csv(imp_final$loggedEvents, "imputation_logged_events.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_logged_events.csv\n\n")
} else {
  cat("✓ No logged events - imputation completed without issues\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART B: CONVERGENCE DIAGNOSTICS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: CONVERGENCE DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("PURPOSE: Verify that imputation chains have converged\n")
cat("  • Trace plots should show random scatter (no trends)\n")
cat("  • Chains should mix well (overlap)\n")
cat("  • No systematic patterns indicate good convergence\n\n")

# Select variables to plot (representative sample)
vars_to_plot <- c(
  # Demographics
  "age", "education", "income",
  # Health
  "phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "med_quant",
  # Personality - highest missingness
  "ciss11", "ciss21", "surps17", "surps23",
  # Adverse effects
  "side_effects_1", "safety_1", "dependence_1",
  # COM-B
  "motivation_1", "desires_1", "capability"
)

# Filter to only variables that were actually imputed
vars_to_plot <- vars_to_plot[vars_to_plot %in% names(imp_params$method[imp_params$method != ""])]

cat("Creating trace plots for", length(vars_to_plot), "representative variables...\n\n")

# Create trace plots
png("convergence_trace_plots.png", width = 12, height = 16, units = "in", res = 300)
plot(imp_final, vars_to_plot)
dev.off()

cat("✓ Saved: convergence_trace_plots.png\n\n")

cat("INTERPRETATION GUIDE:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  ✓ GOOD: Lines overlap, random variation, no trends\n")
cat("  ⚠️  CONCERN: Chains separated, trends visible, non-mixing\n")
cat("  → If convergence issues seen, may need to increase maxit\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: DISTRIBUTION DIAGNOSTICS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: DISTRIBUTION DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("PURPOSE: Check if imputed values have reasonable distributions\n")
cat("  • Red = observed data\n")
cat("  • Blue = imputed data\n")
cat("  • Distributions should be similar\n\n")

# Select continuous variables for plotting
continuous_to_plot <- vars_to_plot[vars_to_plot %in% imp_params$variable_types$continuous]

if(length(continuous_to_plot) > 0) {
  cat("Creating density plots for", length(continuous_to_plot), "variables...\n\n")
  
  vars_for_density <- head(continuous_to_plot, 8)  # Plot up to 8 variables
  
  formula_str <- paste("~", paste(vars_for_density, collapse = " + "))
  density_formula <- as.formula(formula_str)
  
  png("imputation_density_plots.png", width = 14, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
  print(densityplot(imp_final, density_formula))
  dev.off()
  
  cat("✓ Saved: imputation_density_plots.png\n")
  cat("  Variables plotted:", paste(vars_for_density, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("No continuous variables to plot\n\n")
}

cat("INTERPRETATION GUIDE:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  ✓ GOOD: Imputed (blue) similar to observed (red)\n")
cat("  ⚠️  CONCERN: Very different distributions\n")
cat("  → Large differences may indicate MAR assumption violated\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: IMPUTATION QUALITY ASSESSMENT
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: IMPUTATION QUALITY ASSESSMENT\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Calculating imputation diagnostics...\n\n")

# Get imputed values statistics
complete_data <- complete(imp_final, action = "long", include = TRUE)

# Calculate mean and SD for imputed vs observed for key variables
quality_assessment <- data.frame()

for(var in continuous_to_plot) {
  if(var %in% names(df_imp)) {
    # Observed values
    obs_mean <- mean(df_imp[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    obs_sd <- sd(df_imp[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Imputed values (from all imputations)
    imputed_only <- complete_data[complete_data$.imp > 0 & is.na(df_imp[[var]][complete_data$.id]), ]
    
    if(nrow(imputed_only) > 0) {
      imp_mean <- mean(imputed_only[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      imp_sd <- sd(imputed_only[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      
      quality_assessment <- rbind(quality_assessment, data.frame(
        variable = var,
        observed_mean = obs_mean,
        observed_sd = obs_sd,
        imputed_mean = imp_mean,
        imputed_sd = imp_sd,
        mean_diff = imp_mean - obs_mean,
        sd_ratio = imp_sd / obs_sd
      ))
    }
  }
}

if(nrow(quality_assessment) > 0) {
  cat("QUALITY METRICS (Continuous Variables):\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  print(quality_assessment, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
  cat("\n")
  
  write.csv(quality_assessment, "imputation_quality_assessment.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("✓ Saved: imputation_quality_assessment.csv\n\n")
  
  cat("INTERPRETATION:\n")
  cat("  • mean_diff close to 0 = good agreement\n")
  cat("  • sd_ratio close to 1.0 = similar variability\n")
  cat("  • Large deviations may indicate issues\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: RECALCULATE DERIVED VARIABLES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: RECALCULATING DERIVED VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(!is.null(imp_params$derived_variables_to_recalculate) && 
   length(imp_params$derived_variables_to_recalculate) > 0) {
  
  cat("Variables to recalculate:\n")
  for(var in imp_params$derived_variables_to_recalculate) {
    cat("  •", var, "\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  # Recalculate n_health_conditions for each imputed dataset
  cat("Recalculating n_health_conditions for all", imp_params$optimal_m, "imputations...\n")
  
  for(i in 1:imp_params$optimal_m) {
    # Get the i-th imputed dataset
    imp_data <- complete(imp_final, i)
    
    # Recalculate n_health_conditions
    imp_data$n_health_conditions <- imp_data$n_physical_conditions + 
                                     imp_data$n_ment_conditions + 
                                     imp_data$n_sleep_conditions
    
    # Put it back into the mids object
    imp_final$data <- imp_data
    
    # Store in the appropriate slot
    if(i == 1) {
      # Initialize the storage
      imp_final$data$n_health_conditions <- imp_data$n_health_conditions
    }
  }
  
  # Add n_health_conditions to all complete datasets
  for(i in 1:imp_params$optimal_m) {
    imp_data <- complete(imp_final, i)
    imp_data$n_health_conditions <- imp_data$n_physical_conditions + 
                                     imp_data$n_ment_conditions + 
                                     imp_data$n_sleep_conditions
    
    # Store this modified dataset
    if(i == 1) {
      all_imputed <- list(imp_data)
    } else {
      all_imputed[[i]] <- imp_data
    }
  }
  
  cat("✓ Recalculated n_health_conditions for all imputations\n\n")
  
  # Verify calculation
  cat("VERIFICATION:\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  imp_sample <- all_imputed[[1]]
  n_checks <- sum(imp_sample$n_health_conditions == 
                   (imp_sample$n_physical_conditions + 
                    imp_sample$n_ment_conditions + 
                    imp_sample$n_sleep_conditions))
  
  cat("  Checked first imputation:\n")
  cat("  Correct calculations:", n_checks, "/", nrow(imp_sample), "\n")
  if(n_checks == nrow(imp_sample)) {
    cat("  ✓ All values correctly calculated\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠️  Some values may be incorrect - investigate!\n\n")
  }
  
  # Save modified imputation object
  saveRDS(all_imputed, "imputed_datasets_list.rds")
  cat("✓ Saved: imputed_datasets_list.rds\n")
  cat("  (List of", length(all_imputed), "complete datasets with n_health_conditions)\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("No derived variables to recalculate\n\n")
  
  # Save imputed datasets as list
  all_imputed <- list()
  for(i in 1:imp_params$optimal_m) {
    all_imputed[[i]] <- complete(imp_final, i)
  }
  saveRDS(all_imputed, "imputed_datasets_list.rds")
  cat("✓ Saved: imputed_datasets_list.rds\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: ADD OUTCOME VARIABLE BACK
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: ADDING OUTCOME VARIABLE BACK\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load original dataset to get outcome
if(file.exists("SIMOA_analysis.rds")) {
  SIMOA_original <- readRDS("SIMOA_analysis.rds")
  outcome_var <- imp_params$excluded_variables[grep("scrn_stopped_bzra", 
                                                     imp_params$excluded_variables)]
  
  if(length(outcome_var) > 0 && outcome_var %in% names(SIMOA_original)) {
    cat("Adding outcome variable:", outcome_var, "\n")
    
    outcome_data <- SIMOA_original[[outcome_var]]
    
    # Add outcome to each imputed dataset
    for(i in 1:length(all_imputed)) {
      all_imputed[[i]][[outcome_var]] <- outcome_data
    }
    
    cat("✓ Outcome variable added to all", length(all_imputed), "datasets\n\n")
    
    # Verify
    cat("VERIFICATION:\n")
    cat("  Outcome distribution in first imputation:\n")
    print(table(all_imputed[[1]][[outcome_var]], useNA = "ifany"))
    cat("\n")
    
    # Save final datasets
    saveRDS(all_imputed, "imputed_datasets_final.rds")
    cat("✓ Saved: imputed_datasets_final.rds\n")
    cat("  (Complete datasets ready for analysis)\n\n")
    
  } else {
    cat("⚠️  Outcome variable not found in original dataset\n\n")
    saveRDS(all_imputed, "imputed_datasets_final.rds")
  }
} else {
  cat("⚠️  Original dataset not found - cannot add outcome\n\n")
  saveRDS(all_imputed, "imputed_datasets_final.rds")
}

# Save the mids object as well
saveRDS(imp_final, "mice_imputation_object.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: mice_imputation_object.rds\n")
cat("  (For use with mice pooling functions)\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART G: FINAL SUMMARY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("IMPUTATION COMPLETE - SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("IMPUTATION SPECIFICATIONS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(df_imp), "\n")
cat("  Variables imputed:", imp_params$n_vars_to_impute, "\n")
cat("  Number of imputations (m):", imp_params$optimal_m, "\n")
cat("  Iterations (maxit):", imp_params$optimal_maxit, "\n")
cat("  Time elapsed:", round(as.numeric(elapsed_time), 2), "minutes\n\n")

cat("IMPUTATION METHODS:\n")
cat("  PMM (continuous):", sum(imp_params$method == "pmm"), "variables\n")
cat("  Logreg (binary):", sum(imp_params$method == "logreg"), "variables\n")
cat("  Polr (ordered):", sum(imp_params$method == "polr"), "variables\n")
cat("  Polyreg (unordered):", sum(imp_params$method == "polyreg"), "variables\n\n")

cat("POST-PROCESSING:\n")
if(length(imp_params$derived_variables_to_recalculate) > 0) {
  cat("  ✓ Derived variables recalculated:", 
      paste(imp_params$derived_variables_to_recalculate, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
cat("  ✓ Outcome variable added back\n")
cat("  ✓ Final datasets complete and ready for analysis\n\n")

cat("CONVERGENCE STATUS:\n")
if(nrow(imp_final$loggedEvents) == 0) {
  cat("  ✓ No convergence issues detected\n")
} else {
  cat("  ⚠️", nrow(imp_final$loggedEvents), "logged events\n")
  cat("     Review convergence_trace_plots.png and imputation_logged_events.csv\n")
}
cat("\n")

cat("FILES CREATED:\n")
cat("  1. mice_imputation_object.rds - MICE mids object\n")
cat("  2. imputed_datasets_list.rds - List of complete datasets (with n_health_conditions)\n")
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTION: SUBSCALE RELIABILITY ASSESSMENT
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

assess_subscale_reliability <- function(data, items, name, scale_range = NULL) {
  
  # Check if all items exist
  missing_items <- items[!items %in% names(data)]
  if(length(missing_items) > 0) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      status = "MISSING ITEMS"
    ))
  }
  
  # Extract item data
  item_data <- data %>% 
    select(all_of(items)) %>% 
    na.omit()
  
  n_complete <- nrow(item_data)
  
  # Need at least 10 cases
  if(n_complete < 10) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      status = "INSUFFICIENT DATA"
    ))
  }
  
  # Convert to numeric
  item_matrix <- as.data.frame(lapply(item_data, as.numeric))
  
  # Check variance
  item_sds <- sapply(item_matrix, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(any(item_sds == 0 | is.na(item_sds))) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      status = "NO VARIANCE"
    ))
  }
  
  # Calculate Cronbach's alpha
  alpha_result <- tryCatch({
    psych::alpha(item_matrix, check.keys = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if(is.null(alpha_result)) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      status = "ALPHA FAILED"
    ))
  }
  
  # Extract metrics
  alpha <- alpha_result$total$raw_alpha
  alpha_ci_lower <- alpha_result$feldt$lower.ci
  alpha_ci_upper <- alpha_result$feldt$upper.ci
  
  # Inter-item correlations
  cor_matrix <- cor(item_matrix, use = "complete.obs")
  cor_vector <- cor_matrix[lower.tri(cor_matrix)]
  mean_inter_item_r <- mean(cor_vector, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Calculate subscale scores (MEAN)
  subscale_scores <- rowMeans(item_matrix, na.rm = FALSE)
  
  # Descriptive statistics
  mean_score <- mean(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_score <- sd(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_score <- min(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_score <- max(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Quality assessment
  status <- if(alpha >= 0.70) "GOOD" else if(alpha >= 0.60) "ACCEPTABLE" else "POOR"
  
  return(list(
    name = name,
    n_items = length(items),
    alpha = alpha,
    alpha_ci_lower = alpha_ci_lower,
    alpha_ci_upper = alpha_ci_upper,
    mean_inter_item_r = mean_inter_item_r,
    mean = mean_score,
    sd = sd_score,
    min = min_score,
    max = max_score,
    status = status
  ))
}

bfi_subscales <- list(
  Extraversion = c("reserved", "outgoing"),          # reserved already reversed
  Agreeableness = c("find_fault", "trusting"),       # find_fault already reversed
  Conscientiousness = c("lazy", "thorough"),         # lazy already reversed

      reversed_items = intersect(items, c("reserved", "lazy", "relaxed", "few_interests", "find_fault"))

}

  result <- assess_subscale_reliability(
    data = data_imp1,

}

# Create summary table
summary_table <- data.frame()
for(var_name in names(reliability_results)) {
  result <- reliability_results[[var_name]]
  
  # Get reversed items info
  reversed_count <- 0
  for(measure in names(subscales_created)) {
    for(subscale in names(subscales_created[[measure]])) {
      if(subscales_created[[measure]][[subscale]]$variable == var_name) {
        reversed_count <- length(subscales_created[[measure]][[subscale]]$reversed_items)
        break
      }
    }
  }
  
  summary_table <- rbind(summary_table, data.frame(
    Subscale = result$name,
    N_Items = result$n_items,
    N_Reversed = reversed_count,
    Alpha = result$alpha,
    CI_Lower = result$alpha_ci_lower,
    CI_Upper = result$alpha_ci_upper,
    Mean = result$mean,
    SD = result$sd,
    Status = result$status,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}
```

## Descriptive Stats
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 10: DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS & GROUP COMPARISONS
# Pooled across all m imputations using Rubin's Rules
#==============================================================================
#
# POOLING METHODS:
#
#   Continuous variables:
#     - Pooled mean:  Q_bar = mean of per-imputation means
#     - Pooled variance (Rubin's Rules):
#         W = mean of within-imputation variances  (average SE^2)
#         B = variance of per-imputation means     (between-imputation variance)
#         T = W + (1 + 1/m) * B                   (total variance)
#     - Pooled SD reported as sqrt of pooled within-imputation variance (W),
#       which reflects typical within-sample spread, not estimation uncertainty
#     - Group comparison: pool t-statistics via Li et al. (1991) method,
#       which gives a valid p-value from pooled F/t
#
#   Categorical variables:
#     - Pooled proportion: mean of per-imputation proportions per level
#     - Pooled n(%): pooled proportion * N
#     - Group comparison: pool chi-square statistics (mean across imputations),
#       test against chi-square distribution (Enders, 2010 approach)
#
#   Effect sizes:
#     - Cohen's d: computed from pooled means and pooled within-SD
#     - Cramer's V: computed from pooled chi-square statistic
#
#   FDR: Benjamini-Hochberg applied to pooled p-values within families
#
# REFERENCES:
#   Rubin, D.B. (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys.
#   Li, K.H., Raghunathan, T.E., & Rubin, D.B. (1991). Statistica Sinica.
#   Enders, C.K. (2010). Applied Missing Data Analysis.
#   Benjamini, Y., & Hochberg, Y. (1995). JRSS-B, 57(1), 289-300.
#==============================================================================

library(mice)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

cat("\n")
cat("===============================================================\n")
cat("DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS & GROUP COMPARISONS\n")
cat("(Pooled across all imputations — Rubin's Rules)\n")
cat("===============================================================\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD DATA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if(!file.exists("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: imputed_data_with_subscales.rds not found. Run Chunk 9 first.")

imp_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
m        <- imp_data$m
N        <- nrow(mice::complete(imp_data, 1))

cat(sprintf("Loaded imputed data: m = %d imputations, N = %d\n\n", m, N))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RECODE FUNCTION — applied to each imputed dataset
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

recode_dataset <- function(df) {

  # Sex
  if("sex" %in% names(df))
    df$sex <- factor(df$sex, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("Female","Male"))

  # Province/Territory
  if("prov_terr" %in% names(df)) {
    df$prov_terr <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$prov_terr %in% c(1,2,3,12) ~ "Western Canada",
      df$prov_terr %in% c(9,11)     ~ "Central Canada",
      df$prov_terr %in% c(4,5,7,10) ~ "Atlantic Canada",
      TRUE                           ~ "Territories"
    )
    df$prov_terr <- factor(df$prov_terr,
      levels = c("Western Canada","Central Canada","Atlantic Canada","Territories"))
  }

  # Employment
  if("employment" %in% names(df)) {
    df$employment <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$employment %in% c(0,3,4) ~ "Not in Workforce",
      df$employment %in% c(1,2)   ~ "Full- or Part-Time Work",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$employment <- factor(df$employment,
      levels = c("Full- or Part-Time Work","Not in Workforce"))
  }

  # Education
  if("education" %in% names(df)) {
    df$education <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$education %in% c(1,2,3) ~ "High School or Less",
      df$education %in% c(4,5)   ~ "Trade School/University Degree",
      TRUE                        ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$education <- factor(df$education,
      levels = c("High School or Less","Trade School/University Degree"))
  }

  # Income
  if("income" %in% names(df))
    df$income <- factor(df$income, levels = 1:5,
      labels = c("$15,000 or less","$15,000 to $30,000","$30,000 to $50,000",
                 "$50,000 to $80,000","$80,000 or more"))

  # Driving frequency
  if("driving_freq" %in% names(df))
    df$driving_freq <- factor(df$driving_freq, levels = 0:3,
      labels = c("Do not drive","Less than 1 day/week","1-3 days/week","4-7 days/week"))

  # General health
  if("gen_health" %in% names(df))
    df$gen_health <- factor(df$gen_health, levels = 1:5,
      labels = c("Poor","Fair","Good","Very good","Excellent"))

  # Sleep substance use frequency
  sleep_freq_labels <- c("Less than 1 day/week","1-3 days/week",
                         "4-6 days/week","7 days/week")
  for(sv in c("alc_sleep","can_sleep","melatonin_use","op_sleep"))
    if(sv %in% names(df))
      df[[sv]] <- factor(df[[sv]], levels = 1:4, labels = sleep_freq_labels)

  # Withdrawal experience
  if("stop_wdl_exp_combined" %in% names(df))
    df$stop_wdl_exp_combined <- factor(df$stop_wdl_exp_combined, levels = 0:5,
      labels = c("No withdrawal","Insomnia only","Anxiety only",
                 "Other MH symptoms only","Physical symptoms only","Multiple symptoms"))

  # Likert scales to numeric
  for(var in c(paste0("side_effects_",1:4), paste0("safety_",1:4),
               paste0("adls_",1:2), paste0("dependence_",1:3)))
    if(var %in% names(df) && !is.numeric(df[[var]]))
      df[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(df[[var]]))

  df
}

#==============================================================================
# POOLING FUNCTIONS
#==============================================================================

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# POOL CONTINUOUS VARIABLE
# Returns: overall Mean(SD), group means/SDs, pooled t-test p-value, Cohen's d
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pool_continuous <- function(var, datasets, outcome = "scrn_stopped_bzra") {

  # Per-imputation statistics
  imp_stats <- lapply(datasets, function(df) {
    x   <- as.numeric(df[[var]])
    grp <- df[[outcome]]
    x0  <- x[grp == 0]; x1 <- x[grp == 1]
    n0  <- sum(!is.na(x0)); n1 <- sum(!is.na(x1))
    if(n0 < 2 || n1 < 2) return(NULL)

    m0  <- mean(x0, na.rm=TRUE); m1 <- mean(x1, na.rm=TRUE)
    v0  <- var(x0, na.rm=TRUE);  v1 <- var(x1, na.rm=TRUE)
    m_all <- mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)
    v_all <- var(x, na.rm=TRUE)

    # Pooled within-group SD for Cohen's d
    sp  <- sqrt(((n0-1)*v0 + (n1-1)*v1) / (n0+n1-2))

    # Standard error of mean difference (for Rubin's pooling)
    se_diff <- sqrt(v0/n0 + v1/n1)

    list(m_all=m_all, v_all=v_all,
         m0=m0, v0=v0, n0=n0,
         m1=m1, v1=v1, n1=n1,
         diff=m1-m0, se_diff=se_diff, sp=sp)
  })
  imp_stats <- Filter(Negate(is.null), imp_stats)
  if(length(imp_stats) == 0) return(NULL)

  mm <- length(imp_stats)

  # Pool overall
  pool_m_all  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "m_all"))
  pool_v_all  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "v_all"))   # pooled within-imputation variance
  pool_sd_all <- sqrt(pool_v_all)

  # Pool group 0
  pool_m0  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "m0"))
  pool_v0  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "v0"))
  pool_sd0 <- sqrt(pool_v0)
  n0       <- round(mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "n0")))

  # Pool group 1
  pool_m1  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "m1"))
  pool_v1  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "v1"))
  pool_sd1 <- sqrt(pool_v1)
  n1       <- round(mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "n1")))

  # Rubin's Rules for mean difference
  diffs  <- sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "diff")
  se2s   <- sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "se_diff")^2
  Q_bar  <- mean(diffs)                             # pooled estimate
  W      <- mean(se2s)                              # within-imputation variance
  B      <- var(diffs)                              # between-imputation variance
  T_var  <- W + (1 + 1/mm) * B                     # total variance (Rubin 1987)
  t_stat <- Q_bar / sqrt(T_var)

  # Barnard-Rubin degrees of freedom
  lambda <- (1 + 1/mm) * B / T_var
  df_old <- (n0 + n1 - 2)
  df_obs <- (1 - lambda) * df_old * (df_old + 1) / (df_old + 3)
  df_m   <- (mm - 1) / lambda^2
  df     <- 1 / (1/df_m + 1/df_obs)
  p_val  <- 2 * pt(abs(t_stat), df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)

  # Cohen's d from pooled means and pooled within-group SD
  pool_sp <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "sp"))
  d       <- if(pool_sp > 0) Q_bar / pool_sp else NA_real_
  se_d    <- sqrt((n0+n1)/(n0*n1) + d^2 / (2*(n0+n1-2)))

  list(
    type         = "continuous",
    overall_desc = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", pool_m_all, pool_sd_all),
    cont_desc    = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", pool_m0,    pool_sd0),
    disc_desc    = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", pool_m1,    pool_sd1),
    p_val        = p_val,
    effect_type  = "Cohens_d",
    effect_size  = round(d, 3),
    ci_low       = round(d - 1.96*se_d, 3),
    ci_high      = round(d + 1.96*se_d, 3)
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# POOL CATEGORICAL VARIABLE
# Returns: per-level pooled n(%), pooled chi-square p-value, Cramer's V
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pool_categorical <- function(var, datasets, outcome = "scrn_stopped_bzra") {

  lvls <- levels(datasets[[1]][[var]])
  if(is.null(lvls)) return(NULL)

  imp_stats <- lapply(datasets, function(df) {
    # Build a complete table with ALL levels present (even if count = 0)
    # using factor() to enforce level structure before tabling
    fac_var <- factor(df[[var]], levels = lvls)
    fac_out <- factor(df[[outcome]], levels = c("0","1"))
    tab <- table(fac_var, fac_out)
    colnames(tab) <- c("0","1")

    if(!all(c("0","1") %in% colnames(tab))) return(NULL)

    n0   <- sum(tab[,"0"])
    n1   <- sum(tab[,"1"])
    ntot <- n0 + n1
    if(n0 == 0 || n1 == 0) return(NULL)

    p_all <- tab / ntot
    p0    <- tab[,"0"] / n0
    p1    <- tab[,"1"] / n1

    # Chi-square: only run if all expected counts > 0 in a reduced table
    # (drop levels with zero total count to avoid the error)
    tab_nonzero <- tab[rowSums(tab) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
    chi2 <- tryCatch({
      if(nrow(tab_nonzero) < 2) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab_nonzero, correct = FALSE)$statistic)
      }
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

    list(p_all=p_all, p0=p0, p1=p1, n0=n0, n1=n1, ntot=ntot,
         chi2=chi2, k=length(lvls))
  })
  imp_stats <- Filter(Negate(is.null), imp_stats)
  if(length(imp_stats) == 0) return(NULL)

  n0   <- round(mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "n0")))
  n1   <- round(mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "n1")))
  ntot <- n0 + n1

  # Pool proportions across imputations — each is a named vector over lvls
  # Use sapply to get a lvls x m matrix, then rowMeans
  safe_pool <- function(field) {
    mat <- sapply(imp_stats, function(s) {
      v <- s[[field]]
      # Ensure all levels are present and in correct order
      out <- setNames(rep(0, length(lvls)), lvls)
      out[names(v)] <- v
      out
    })
    if(is.null(dim(mat))) mat <- matrix(mat, nrow=length(lvls))
    rowMeans(mat)
  }

  pool_p_all <- safe_pool("p_all") |> (\(x) { x[] })()
  # p_all is a matrix per imputation; need rowSums first then pool
  pool_p_all <- rowMeans(sapply(imp_stats, function(s) {
    v <- rowSums(s$p_all)
    out <- setNames(rep(0, length(lvls)), lvls)
    out[names(v)] <- v; out
  }))
  pool_p0 <- safe_pool("p0")
  pool_p1 <- safe_pool("p1")

  # Pool chi-square: mean of valid chi-square statistics across imputations
  chi2_vals <- sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "chi2")
  chi2_vals <- chi2_vals[!is.na(chi2_vals)]
  pool_chi2 <- if(length(chi2_vals) > 0) mean(chi2_vals) else NA_real_
  k         <- imp_stats[[1]]$k
  df_chi    <- max(k - 1, 1)
  p_val     <- if(!is.na(pool_chi2)) pchisq(pool_chi2, df=df_chi, lower.tail=FALSE) else NA_real_

  # Cramer's V from pooled chi-square
  # k here is number of levels; min(k,2)-1 avoids dividing by 0 when k=1
  denom_k <- max(min(k, 2) - 1, 1)
  v <- if(!is.na(pool_chi2) && ntot > 0) {
    min(sqrt(pool_chi2 / (ntot * denom_k)), 1)
  } else NA_real_
  se_v <- if(!is.na(v)) sqrt((1 - v^2)^2 / (ntot - 1)) else NA_real_

  # Build per-level rows
  level_rows <- data.frame(
    level        = lvls,
    overall_n    = round(pool_p_all * ntot),
    overall_pct  = round(pool_p_all * 100, 1),
    cont_n       = round(pool_p0 * n0),
    cont_pct     = round(pool_p0 * 100, 1),
    disc_n       = round(pool_p1 * n1),
    disc_pct     = round(pool_p1 * 100, 1),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  level_rows$overall_desc <- sprintf("%d (%.1f)", level_rows$overall_n, level_rows$overall_pct)
  level_rows$cont_desc    <- sprintf("%d (%.1f)", level_rows$cont_n,    level_rows$cont_pct)
  level_rows$disc_desc    <- sprintf("%d (%.1f)", level_rows$disc_n,    level_rows$disc_pct)

  list(
    type         = "categorical",
    levels       = level_rows,
    p_val        = p_val,
    effect_type  = "Cramers_V",
    effect_size  = if(!is.na(v)) round(v, 3) else NA_real_,
    ci_low       = if(!is.na(v) && !is.na(se_v)) round(max(0, v - 1.96*se_v), 3) else NA_real_,
    ci_high      = if(!is.na(v) && !is.na(se_v)) round(min(1, v + 1.96*se_v), 3) else NA_real_
  )
}

#==============================================================================
# RUN POOLING FOR ALL VARIABLES
#==============================================================================

cat("===============================================================\n")
cat("POOLING STATISTICS ACROSS ALL IMPUTATIONS\n")
cat("===============================================================\n\n")

pooled_results <- list()

for(var in all_vars) {
  cat(sprintf("  Pooling: %s\n", var))
  if(var %in% cat_vars) {
    pooled_results[[var]] <- pool_categorical(var, all_datasets)
  } else {
    pooled_results[[var]] <- pool_continuous(var, all_datasets)
  }
}
cat("\nDone pooling.\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# EFFECT SIZE INTERPRETATION
#==============================================================================

interpret_d <- function(d) {
  d <- abs(d)
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(d)  ~ "N/A",
    d < 0.20  ~ "Negligible",
    d < 0.50  ~ "Small",
    d < 0.80  ~ "Medium",
    TRUE      ~ "Large"
  )
}

interpret_v <- function(v) {
  v <- abs(v)
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(v)  ~ "N/A",
    v < 0.10  ~ "Negligible",
    v < 0.30  ~ "Small",
    v < 0.50  ~ "Medium",
    TRUE      ~ "Large"
  )
}

#==============================================================================
# BUILD RESULTS DATA FRAME
# One summary row per variable (for p-values, FDR, effect sizes)
# Plus sub-rows for categorical levels
#==============================================================================

summary_rows <- map_df(all_vars, function(var) {
  res <- pooled_results[[var]]
  if(is.null(res)) return(NULL)

  fam  <- get_family(var)
  p    <- res$p_val
  es   <- res$effect_size
  etype <- res$effect_type

  interp <- if(etype == "Cohens_d") interpret_d(es) else interpret_v(es)

  data.frame(
    variable     = var,
    Family       = fam,
    p_val        = p,
    effect_type  = etype,
    effect_size  = es,
    ci_low       = res$ci_low,
    ci_high      = res$ci_high,
    interpretation = interp,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

# FDR correction within families
summary_rows <- summary_rows %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p_val, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

#==============================================================================
# BUILD DISPLAY TABLE
#==============================================================================

format_p <- function(p) {
  if(is.na(p)) return("")
  if(p < 0.001) return("< .001")
  sprintf("%.3f", p)
}

format_sig <- function(p) {
  if(is.na(p)) return("")
  if(p < 0.001) return("***")
  if(p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if(p < 0.05)  return("*")
  return("")
}

format_es <- function(etype, es, lo, hi) {
  if(is.na(es)) return("")
  if(etype == "Cohens_d")  return(sprintf("d = %+.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", es, lo, hi))
  if(etype == "Cramers_V") return(sprintf("V = %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]",  es, lo, hi))
  return("")
}

table_rows <- list()

for(var in all_vars) {
  res  <- pooled_results[[var]]
  srow <- summary_rows[summary_rows$variable == var, ]
  if(is.null(res) || nrow(srow) == 0) next

  fam <- srow$Family

  if(res$type == "continuous") {
    # Single row for continuous variable
    table_rows[[length(table_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
      Family       = fam,
      Variable     = var,
      is_subrow    = FALSE,
      Overall      = res$overall_desc,
      Continued    = res$cont_desc,
      Discontinued = res$disc_desc,
      p            = format_p(srow$p_val),
      p_FDR        = format_p(srow$p_fdr),
      Sig          = format_sig(srow$p_fdr),
      ES           = format_es(srow$effect_type, srow$effect_size, srow$ci_low, srow$ci_high),
      Interpretation = srow$interpretation,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

  } else {
    # Parent row (blank descriptives)
    table_rows[[length(table_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
      Family       = fam,
      Variable     = var,
      is_subrow    = FALSE,
      Overall      = "",
      Continued    = "",
      Discontinued = "",
      p            = format_p(srow$p_val),
      p_FDR        = format_p(srow$p_fdr),
      Sig          = format_sig(srow$p_fdr),
      ES           = format_es(srow$effect_type, srow$effect_size, srow$ci_low, srow$ci_high),
      Interpretation = srow$interpretation,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    # Sub-rows for each level
    for(j in seq_len(nrow(res$levels))) {
      lv <- res$levels[j, ]
      table_rows[[length(table_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
        Family       = fam,
        Variable     = paste0("    ", lv$level),
        is_subrow    = TRUE,
        Overall      = lv$overall_desc,
        Continued    = lv$cont_desc,
        Discontinued = lv$disc_desc,
        p            = "",
        p_FDR        = "",
        Sig          = "",
        ES           = "",
        Interpretation = "",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

display_table <- bind_rows(table_rows) %>%
  select(Family, Variable, Overall, Continued, Discontinued,
         p, p_FDR, Sig, `Effect Size [95% CI]` = ES, Interpretation)

#==============================================================================
# PRINT TABLE 2
#==============================================================================

cat("===============================================================\n")
cat("TABLE 2: GROUP COMPARISONS (Pooled MI — Rubin's Rules)\n")
cat("===============================================================\n\n")

print(display_table, row.names = FALSE, na.print = "")
cat("\n")

# Save with labelled columns
out_table <- display_table
names(out_table) <- c(
  "Family", "Variable",
  sprintf("Overall (N=%d)", n_total),
  sprintf("Continued (n=%d)", n_continued),
  sprintf("Discontinued (n=%d)", n_discontinued),
  "p (uncorrected)", "p (FDR-corrected)", "Sig (FDR)",
  "Effect Size [95% CI]", "Interpretation"
)
write.csv(out_table, "TABLE2_publication_ready_with_FDR.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: TABLE2_publication_ready_with_FDR.csv\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# TABLE 1: OVERALL SAMPLE (pooled)
#==============================================================================

cat("===============================================================\n")
cat("TABLE 1: OVERALL SAMPLE CHARACTERISTICS (Pooled MI)\n")
cat("===============================================================\n\n")

table1_rows <- list()
for(var in all_vars) {
  res <- pooled_results[[var]]
  if(is.null(res)) next

  if(res$type == "continuous") {
    table1_rows[[length(table1_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
      Variable = var,
      Overall  = res$overall_desc,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    table1_rows[[length(table1_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
      Variable = var, Overall = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    for(j in seq_len(nrow(res$levels))) {
      lv <- res$levels[j, ]
      table1_rows[[length(table1_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
        Variable = paste0("    ", lv$level),
        Overall  = lv$overall_desc,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

table1_display <- bind_rows(table1_rows)
print(table1_display, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(table1_display, "TABLE1_overall_characteristics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSaved: TABLE1_overall_characteristics.csv\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# FDR SUMMARY BY FAMILY
#==============================================================================

cat("===============================================================\n")
cat("FDR SUMMARY BY FAMILY\n")
cat("===============================================================\n\n")

fdr_summary <- summary_rows %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(
    k         = n(),
    n_sig_raw = sum(!is.na(p_val) & p_val < 0.05),
    n_sig_fdr = sum(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(fdr_summary, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")
write.csv(fdr_summary, "TABLE2_FDR_summary_by_family.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: TABLE2_FDR_summary_by_family.csv\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# SIGNIFICANT VARIABLES
#==============================================================================

sig_vars <- summary_rows %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(p_fdr)

if(nrow(sig_vars) > 0) {
  cat("SIGNIFICANT VARIABLES (FDR-corrected) WITH EFFECT SIZES:\n")
  cat("-------------------------------------------------------------\n")
  print(sig_vars %>%
          select(Family, variable, p_val, p_fdr, effect_type, effect_size, interpretation),
        row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  write.csv(sig_vars, "TABLE2_significant_variables_FDR.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Saved: TABLE2_significant_variables_FDR.csv\n\n")
} else {
  cat("No variables significant after FDR correction.\n\n")
}

#==============================================================================
# NOTABLE EFFECT SIZES (medium or large)
#==============================================================================

notable <- summary_rows %>%
  filter(interpretation %in% c("Medium","Large")) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(effect_size)))

if(nrow(notable) > 0) {
  cat("NOTABLE EFFECT SIZES (medium or large):\n")
  cat("-------------------------------------------------------------\n")
  cat("Note: listed regardless of statistical significance\n\n")
  print(notable %>%
          select(Family, variable, effect_type, effect_size, ci_low, ci_high, interpretation),
        row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
}

#==============================================================================
# MANUSCRIPT TEXT SNIPPET
#==============================================================================

cat("===============================================================\n")
cat("MANUSCRIPT TEXT SNIPPET\n")
cat("===============================================================\n\n")

age_res <- pooled_results[["age"]]
cat("Sample Characteristics:\n")
cat("-------------------------------------------------------------\n")
if(!is.null(age_res)) {
  cat(sprintf("The final sample comprised %d older adults (%s years).\n",
              n_total, age_res$overall_desc))
}

sex_res <- pooled_results[["sex"]]
if(!is.null(sex_res)) {
  female_row <- sex_res$levels[sex_res$levels$level == "Female", ]
  if(nrow(female_row) > 0)
    cat(sprintf("The sample was %.1f%% female (n = %d).\n",
                female_row$overall_pct, female_row$overall_n))
}

cat(sprintf("\nOf the %d participants, %d (%.1f%%) reported discontinuing their\n",
            n_total, n_discontinued, 100*n_discontinued/n_total))
cat(sprintf("BZRA medication; %d (%.1f%%) continued use.\n\n",
            n_continued, 100*n_continued/n_total))

cat("Group Comparisons:\n")
cat("-------------------------------------------------------------\n")
if(nrow(sig_vars) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("After FDR correction within variable families (Benjamini & Hochberg, 1995),\n"))
  cat(sprintf("those who discontinued differed significantly from those who continued\n"))
  cat(sprintf("on %d variable(s):\n\n", nrow(sig_vars)))
  for(i in seq_len(min(5, nrow(sig_vars)))) {
    es_label <- ifelse(sig_vars$effect_type[i] == "Cohens_d", "d", "V")
    dir_note <- if(sig_vars$effect_type[i] == "Cohens_d" && sig_vars$effect_size[i] > 0) {
      "(higher in discontinued)"
    } else if(sig_vars$effect_type[i] == "Cohens_d") {
      "(lower in discontinued)"
    } else ""
    cat(sprintf("  %s: p_FDR = %.4f, %s = %.2f %s [%s]\n",
                sig_vars$variable[i], sig_vars$p_fdr[i],
                es_label, sig_vars$effect_size[i],
                dir_note, sig_vars$interpretation[i]))
  }
  if(nrow(sig_vars) > 5) cat("  ... and", nrow(sig_vars)-5, "more\n")
} else {
  cat("After FDR correction, no significant baseline differences were observed\n")
  cat("between those who discontinued and those who continued BZRA use.\n")
}

cat("\nStatistical Methods:\n")
cat("-------------------------------------------------------------\n")
cat(sprintf("Descriptive statistics and group comparisons were computed across all\n"))
cat(sprintf("%d imputed datasets and pooled using Rubin's (1987) Rules.\n", m))
cat("For continuous variables, pooled means and within-imputation SDs are\n")
cat("reported. Group differences were tested using pooled t-statistics with\n")
cat("Barnard-Rubin degrees of freedom; effect sizes are Cohen's d computed\n")
cat("from pooled means and pooled within-group SDs (positive values indicate\n")
cat("higher scores in the discontinued group). For categorical variables,\n")
cat("pooled proportions are reported as n (%); group differences were tested\n")
cat("using the mean pooled chi-square statistic (Enders, 2010); effect sizes\n")
cat("are Cramer's V. FDR correction (Benjamini & Hochberg, 1995) was applied\n")
cat("within five variable families:\n")
cat(sprintf("demographics (k=%d), clinical (k=%d), sleep/adverse effects (k=%d),\n",
            sum(all_vars %in% demographics), sum(all_vars %in% clinical),
            sum(all_vars %in% sleep_adverse)))
cat(sprintf("behavioural (k=%d), and personality (k=%d).\n\n",
            sum(all_vars %in% behavioural), sum(all_vars %in% personality)))

#==============================================================================
# COMPLETE
#==============================================================================

cat("===============================================================\n")
cat("CHUNK 10 COMPLETE\n")
cat("===============================================================\n\n")
cat("FILES CREATED:\n")
cat("  1. TABLE1_overall_characteristics.csv\n")
cat("  2. TABLE2_publication_ready_with_FDR.csv\n")
cat("  3. TABLE2_FDR_summary_by_family.csv\n")
if(nrow(sig_vars) > 0)
  cat("  4. TABLE2_significant_variables_FDR.csv\n")
cat("\nNOTES:\n")
cat("  - All estimates pooled across", m, "imputations (Rubin's Rules)\n")
cat("  - Continuous: Mean (pooled within-imputation SD)\n")
cat("  - Categorical: n (pooled %)\n")
cat("  - Cohen's d: positive = higher in discontinued group\n")
cat("  - Cramer's V: always positive\n\n")
cat("REFERENCES:\n")
cat("  Rubin, D.B. (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys.\n")
cat("  Li et al. (1991). Statistica Sinica, 1(1), 65-92.\n")
cat("  Enders, C.K. (2010). Applied Missing Data Analysis.\n")
cat("  Benjamini & Hochberg (1995). JRSS-B, 57(1), 289-300.\n")
cat("  Cohen, J. (1988). Statistical Power Analysis (2nd ed.).\n\n")
```





## PERS VSURF
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 11A: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (PERSONALITY PREDICTORS)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Select important personality variables for BZRA discontinuation
# Strategy: Apply VSURF to personality subscales (BFI, SURPS, DBAS, CISS)
# Rationale: Reduce high-dimensional correlated personality block
# Output: Reduced set of personality predictors for logistic regression
#==============================================================================

library(VSURF)
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11A: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (PERSONALITY)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load imputed data with subscales
if(!file.exists("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run Chunk 9 first to create subscales")
}

mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded imputed data with", mids_data$m, "imputations\n\n")

# Get outcome variable
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

# ==============================================================================
# DEFINE PERSONALITY VARIABLES
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DEFINING PERSONALITY VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Personality subscales (created in Chunk 9)
personality_vars <- c(
  # BFI-10 (Big Five)
  "BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Agreeableness", "BFI_Conscientiousness",
  "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Openness",
  
  # SURPS (Substance Use Risk Profile)
  "SURPS_Impulsivity", "SURPS_Sensation_Seeking",
  "SURPS_Hopelessness", "SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity",
  
  # DBAS-16 (Dysfunctional Beliefs About Sleep) - subscales only
  "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness",
  "DBAS_Expectations", "DBAS_Medications",
  
  # CISS (Coping Inventory)
  "CISS_Task", "CISS_Emotion", "CISS_Avoidance"
)

cat("PERSONALITY VARIABLES (", length(personality_vars), "):\n\n", sep = "")
cat("  BFI-10 (5): Extraversion, Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, Neuroticism, Openness\n")
cat("  SURPS (4): Impulsivity, Sensation_Seeking, Hopelessness, Anxiety_Sensitivity\n")
cat("  DBAS-16 (4): Consequences, Worry_Helplessness, Expectations, Medications\n")
cat("  CISS (3): Task, Emotion, Avoidance\n\n")

cat("EXCLUDED:\n")
cat("  • DBAS_Total (sum of subscales - redundant)\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PREPARE DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PREPARING DATA\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Extract first imputation
data_complete <- complete(mids_data, 1)

# Check variable availability
available_vars <- personality_vars[personality_vars %in% names(data_complete)]
missing_vars <- personality_vars[!personality_vars %in% names(data_complete)]

if(length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  WARNING: Missing variables:\n")
  for(var in missing_vars) cat("    •", var, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}

cat("Available personality variables:", length(available_vars), "of", length(personality_vars), "\n\n")

# Prepare predictor matrix
X <- data_complete %>%
  select(all_of(available_vars)) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Prepare outcome
if(!outcome_var %in% names(data_complete)) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable '", outcome_var, "' not found!")
}

y <- data_complete[[outcome_var]]

# Remove missing outcomes
complete_idx <- !is.na(y)
X <- X[complete_idx, ]
y <- y[complete_idx]
y <- factor(y, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Continued", "Discontinued"))
y <- droplevels(y)

cat("Data for VSURF:\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(X), "\n")
cat("  Predictors:", ncol(X), "\n")
cat("  Outcome:", outcome_var, "\n\n")

cat("Outcome distribution:\n")
outcome_table <- table(y)
print(outcome_table)
cat("\n  Discontinuation rate:", round(100 * outcome_table[2] / sum(outcome_table), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Events per variable:", round(outcome_table[2] / ncol(X), 1), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# RUN VSURF
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("RUNNING VSURF\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("VSURF Algorithm:\n")
cat("  1. THRESHOLDING - Remove irrelevant variables\n")
cat("  2. INTERPRETATION - Variables for explanatory models\n")
cat("  3. PREDICTION - Minimal set for pure prediction\n\n")

cat("Running VSURF (may take several minutes)...\n\n")

set.seed(12345)
start_time <- Sys.time()

vsurf_result <- tryCatch({
  VSURF(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    ntree = 2000,
    mtry = max(floor(ncol(X)/3), 1),
    parallel = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("\n✗ ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
  return(NULL)
})

end_time <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 2)

cat("\n✓ VSURF completed in", time_taken, "minutes\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# EXTRACT RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VSURF RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(is.null(vsurf_result)) {
  # Fallback: Standard RF importance
  cat("⚠️  VSURF failed - using fallback (RF importance)\n\n")
  
  set.seed(12345)
  rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)
  
  importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(importance_vals),
    Importance = importance_vals
  ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  
  # Select top 8
  selected_vars <- importance_df$Variable[1:min(8, nrow(importance_df))]
  
  vsurf_threshold <- selected_vars
  vsurf_interpretation <- selected_vars
  vsurf_prediction <- selected_vars[1:min(5, length(selected_vars))]
  
} else {
  # Extract VSURF results
  vsurf_threshold <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres]
  vsurf_interpretation <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.interp]
  vsurf_prediction <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.pred]
  
  # Get importance
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = vsurf_threshold,
      Importance = vsurf_result$imp.varselect.thres
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  } else {
    set.seed(12345)
    rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)
    importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = names(importance_vals),
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  }
  
  selected_vars <- vsurf_interpretation
}

# Display results
cat("STEP 1 - THRESHOLDING:", length(vsurf_threshold), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_threshold)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_threshold[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 2 - INTERPRETATION:", length(vsurf_interpretation), "variables\n")
cat("→ USE THESE FOR EXPLANATORY MODEL\n")
if(length(vsurf_interpretation) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_interpretation)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_interpretation[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 3 - PREDICTION:", length(vsurf_prediction), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_prediction) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_prediction)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_prediction[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

# Variable importance
cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (Top 15):\n")
print(head(importance_df, 15), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

# ==============================================================================
# DOMAIN BREAKDOWN
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SELECTION BY PERSONALITY DOMAIN\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(length(selected_vars) > 0) {
  domain_breakdown <- data.frame(
    Variable = selected_vars,
    Domain = case_when(
      grepl("^BFI_", selected_vars) ~ "BFI",
      grepl("^SURPS_", selected_vars) ~ "SURPS",
      grepl("^DBAS_", selected_vars) ~ "DBAS",
      grepl("^CISS_", selected_vars) ~ "CISS",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% arrange(Domain, Variable)
  
  domain_summary <- domain_breakdown %>%
    count(Domain, name = "N_Selected") %>%
    mutate(
      N_Total = case_when(
        Domain == "BFI" ~ 5,
        Domain == "SURPS" ~ 4,
        Domain == "DBAS" ~ 4,
        Domain == "CISS" ~ 3,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      Percent = round(100 * N_Selected / N_Total, 1)
    )
  
  print(domain_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
  for(domain in unique(domain_breakdown$Domain)) {
    vars_in_domain <- domain_breakdown %>% filter(Domain == domain)
    cat(domain, "(", nrow(vars_in_domain), "):\n", sep = "")
    for(i in 1:nrow(vars_in_domain)) {
      cat("  •", vars_in_domain$Variable[i], "\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION
# ==============================================================================

cat("Creating visualization...\n")

if(nrow(importance_df) > 0) {
  plot_data <- importance_df %>%
    head(15) %>%
    mutate(
      Domain = case_when(
        grepl("^BFI_", Variable) ~ "BFI",
        grepl("^SURPS_", Variable) ~ "SURPS",
        grepl("^DBAS_", Variable) ~ "DBAS",
        grepl("^CISS_", Variable) ~ "CISS",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Selected = Variable %in% selected_vars
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), 
                              y = Importance, fill = Domain, alpha = Selected)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.4),
                       name = "VSURF Selected") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(
      title = "Variable Importance - Personality Predictors",
      subtitle = paste("VSURF selected", length(selected_vars), "of", ncol(X), "variables"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Variable Importance (Mean Decrease Gini)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  ggsave("VSURF_personality_importance.png", p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_importance.png\n\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

vsurf_output <- list(
  vsurf_object = vsurf_result,
  selected_vars = selected_vars,
  vsurf_threshold = vsurf_threshold,
  vsurf_interpretation = vsurf_interpretation,
  vsurf_prediction = vsurf_prediction,
  importance_df = importance_df,
  domain_summary = if(exists("domain_summary")) domain_summary else data.frame(),
  metadata = list(
    outcome = outcome_var,
    n_obs = nrow(X),
    n_input = ncol(X),
    n_selected = length(selected_vars),
    time_minutes = time_taken
  )
)

saveRDS(vsurf_output, "VSURF_personality_results.rds")
saveRDS(selected_vars, "VSURF_personality_selected.rds")

cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_results.rds\n")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_selected.rds\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11A COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("FINAL SELECTION:\n")
cat("  Variables selected:", length(selected_vars), "\n")
```
