```{r}
cat("SELECTED PERSONALITY VARIABLES:\n")

  cat("  ", i, ". ", selected_vars[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")
```

## CLIN VSURF
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 11B: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (CLINICAL PREDICTORS)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Select important clinical/health variables for BZRA discontinuation
# Strategy: Apply VSURF to clinical block
# Rationale: Identify key health and medication factors
# Output: Reduced set of clinical predictors for logistic regression
#==============================================================================

library(VSURF)
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11B: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (CLINICAL)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load imputed data
if(!file.exists("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run Chunk 9 first")
}

mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded imputed data with", mids_data$m, "imputations\n\n")

# Get outcome variable
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

# ==============================================================================
# DEFINE CLINICAL VARIABLES
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DEFINING CLINICAL VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Clinical/health variables
clinical_vars <- c(
  # Basic clinical
  "phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "gen_health", "med_quant",
  
  # Condition counts
  "n_physical_conditions", "n_ment_conditions", 
  "n_sleep_conditions", "n_health_conditions",
  
  # Sleep aids
  "alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep",
  
  # Side effects (continuous Likert)
  paste0("side_effects_", 1:4),
  
  # Safety concerns (continuous Likert)
  paste0("safety_", 1:4),
  
  # ADL impact (continuous Likert)
  paste0("adls_", 1:2),
  
  # Dependence (continuous Likert)
  paste0("dependence_", 1:3)
)

# NOTE: Withdrawal variables EXCLUDED (temporal ordering)
# - stop_wdl_exp_combined
# - wdl_symptom_count

cat("CLINICAL VARIABLES (", length(clinical_vars), "):\n\n", sep = "")
cat("  Basic Clinical (4): phq2_score, osss_3_score, gen_health, med_quant\n")
cat("  Condition Counts (4): n_physical, n_mental, n_sleep, n_health\n")
cat("  Sleep Aids (4): alc_sleep, can_sleep, melatonin_use, op_sleep\n")
cat("  Side Effects (4): side_effects_1-4\n")
cat("  Safety (4): safety_1-4\n")
cat("  ADLs (2): adls_1-2\n")
cat("  Dependence (3): dependence_1-3\n\n")

cat("EXCLUDED (temporal ordering):\n")
cat("  • stop_wdl_exp_combined (occurs during cessation)\n")
cat("  • wdl_symptom_count (occurs during cessation)\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PREPARE DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PREPARING DATA\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Extract first imputation
data_complete <- complete(mids_data, 1)

# Check variable availability
available_vars <- clinical_vars[clinical_vars %in% names(data_complete)]
missing_vars <- clinical_vars[!clinical_vars %in% names(data_complete)]

if(length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  WARNING: Missing variables:\n")
  for(var in missing_vars) cat("    •", var, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}

cat("Available clinical variables:", length(available_vars), "of", length(clinical_vars), "\n\n")

# Prepare predictor matrix
X <- data_complete %>%
  select(all_of(available_vars)) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Prepare outcome
if(!outcome_var %in% names(data_complete)) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable '", outcome_var, "' not found!")
}

y <- data_complete[[outcome_var]]

# Remove missing outcomes
complete_idx <- !is.na(y)
X <- X[complete_idx, ]
y <- y[complete_idx]
y <- factor(y, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Continued", "Discontinued"))
y <- droplevels(y)

cat("Data for VSURF:\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(X), "\n")
cat("  Predictors:", ncol(X), "\n")
cat("  Outcome:", outcome_var, "\n\n")

cat("Outcome distribution:\n")
outcome_table <- table(y)
print(outcome_table)
cat("\n  Discontinuation rate:", round(100 * outcome_table[2] / sum(outcome_table), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Events per variable:", round(outcome_table[2] / ncol(X), 1), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# RUN VSURF
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("RUNNING VSURF\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("VSURF Algorithm:\n")
cat("  1. THRESHOLDING - Remove irrelevant variables\n")
cat("  2. INTERPRETATION - Variables for explanatory models\n")
cat("  3. PREDICTION - Minimal set for pure prediction\n\n")

cat("Running VSURF (may take several minutes)...\n\n")

set.seed(12345)
start_time <- Sys.time()

vsurf_result <- tryCatch({
  VSURF(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    ntree = 2000,
    mtry = max(floor(ncol(X)/3), 1),
    parallel = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("\n✗ ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
  return(NULL)
})

end_time <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 2)

cat("\n✓ VSURF completed in", time_taken, "minutes\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# EXTRACT RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VSURF RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(is.null(vsurf_result)) {
  # Fallback: Standard RF importance
  cat("⚠️  VSURF failed - using fallback (RF importance)\n\n")
  
  set.seed(12345)
  rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)
  
  importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(importance_vals),
    Importance = importance_vals
  ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  
  # Select top 10
  selected_vars <- importance_df$Variable[1:min(10, nrow(importance_df))]
  
  vsurf_threshold <- selected_vars
  vsurf_interpretation <- selected_vars
  vsurf_prediction <- selected_vars[1:min(5, length(selected_vars))]
  
} else {
  # Extract VSURF results
  vsurf_threshold <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres]
  vsurf_interpretation <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.interp]
  vsurf_prediction <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.pred]
  
  # Get importance
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = vsurf_threshold,
      Importance = vsurf_result$imp.varselect.thres
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  } else {
    set.seed(12345)
    rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)
    importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable = names(importance_vals),
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  }
  
  selected_vars <- vsurf_interpretation
}

# Display results
cat("STEP 1 - THRESHOLDING:", length(vsurf_threshold), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_threshold)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_threshold[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 2 - INTERPRETATION:", length(vsurf_interpretation), "variables\n")
cat("→ USE THESE FOR EXPLANATORY MODEL\n")
if(length(vsurf_interpretation) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_interpretation)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_interpretation[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 3 - PREDICTION:", length(vsurf_prediction), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_prediction) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_prediction)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_prediction[i], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat("\n")

# Variable importance
cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (Top 20):\n")
print(head(importance_df, 20), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

# ==============================================================================
# CATEGORY BREAKDOWN
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SELECTION BY CLINICAL CATEGORY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(length(selected_vars) > 0) {
  category_breakdown <- data.frame(
    Variable = selected_vars,
    Category = case_when(
      selected_vars %in% c("phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "gen_health", "med_quant") ~ "Basic Clinical",
      grepl("^n_", selected_vars) ~ "Condition Counts",
      selected_vars %in% c("alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep") ~ "Sleep Aids",
      grepl("^side_effects_", selected_vars) ~ "Side Effects",
      grepl("^safety_", selected_vars) ~ "Safety",
      grepl("^adls_", selected_vars) ~ "ADLs",
      grepl("^dependence_", selected_vars) ~ "Dependence",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% arrange(Category, Variable)
  
  category_summary <- category_breakdown %>%
    count(Category, name = "N_Selected")
  
  print(category_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
  for(category in unique(category_breakdown$Category)) {
    vars_in_cat <- category_breakdown %>% filter(Category == category)
    cat(category, "(", nrow(vars_in_cat), "):\n", sep = "")
    for(i in 1:nrow(vars_in_cat)) {
      cat("  •", vars_in_cat$Variable[i], "\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION
# ==============================================================================

cat("Creating visualization...\n")

if(nrow(importance_df) > 0) {
  plot_data <- importance_df %>%
    head(20) %>%
    mutate(
      Category = case_when(
        Variable %in% c("phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "gen_health", "med_quant") ~ "Basic Clinical",
        grepl("^n_", Variable) ~ "Condition Counts",
        Variable %in% c("alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep") ~ "Sleep Aids",
        grepl("^side_effects_", Variable) ~ "Side Effects",
        grepl("^safety_", Variable) ~ "Safety",
        grepl("^adls_", Variable) ~ "ADLs",
        grepl("^dependence_", Variable) ~ "Dependence",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Selected = Variable %in% selected_vars
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), 
                              y = Importance, fill = Category, alpha = Selected)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.4),
                       name = "VSURF Selected") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(
      title = "Variable Importance - Clinical Predictors",
      subtitle = paste("VSURF selected", length(selected_vars), "of", ncol(X), "variables"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Variable Importance (Mean Decrease Gini)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  ggsave("VSURF_clinical_importance.png", p, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_clinical_importance.png\n\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

vsurf_output <- list(
  vsurf_object = vsurf_result,
  selected_vars = selected_vars,
  vsurf_threshold = vsurf_threshold,
  vsurf_interpretation = vsurf_interpretation,
  vsurf_prediction = vsurf_prediction,
  importance_df = importance_df,
  category_summary = if(exists("category_summary")) category_summary else data.frame(),
  metadata = list(
    outcome = outcome_var,
    n_obs = nrow(X),
    n_input = ncol(X),
    n_selected = length(selected_vars),
    time_minutes = time_taken
  )
)

saveRDS(vsurf_output, "VSURF_clinical_results.rds")
saveRDS(selected_vars, "VSURF_clinical_selected.rds")

cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_clinical_results.rds\n")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_clinical_selected.rds\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11B COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("FINAL SELECTION:\n")
cat("  Variables selected:", length(selected_vars), "\n")
cat("  Sample size:", nrow(X), "\n")
cat("  Events per variable:", round(outcome_table[2] / length(selected_vars), 1), "\n\n")

cat("SELECTED CLINICAL VARIABLES:\n")
for(i in seq_along(selected_vars)) {
  cat("  ", i, ". ", selected_vars[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

cat("✓ Ready for logistic regression modeling\n\n")
```

```{r}
        Component == "Desires" ~ 3,
        Component == "Capability" ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      Percent = round(100 * N_Selected / N_Total, 1)
    )
  
  print(comb_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
  
  for(component in unique(comb_breakdown$Component)) {
    vars_in_comp <- comb_breakdown %>% filter(Component == component)

    for(i in 1:nrow(vars_in_comp)) {
      cat("  •", vars_in_comp$Variable[i], "\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# VISUALIZATION
# ==============================================================================

cat("Creating visualization...\n")

if(nrow(importance_df) > 0) {
  plot_data <- importance_df %>%
    mutate(
      Component = case_when(
        grepl("^motivation_", Variable) ~ "Motivation",
        grepl("^desires_", Variable) ~ "Desires",
        grepl("^capability", Variable) ~ "Capability",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Selected = Variable %in% selected_vars
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), 
                              y = Importance, fill = Component, alpha = Selected)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.4),
                       name = "VSURF Selected") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(
      title = "Variable Importance - Behavioural Predictors (COM-B)",
      subtitle = paste("VSURF selected", length(selected_vars), "of", ncol(X), "variables"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Variable Importance (Mean Decrease Gini)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  ggsave("VSURF_behavioural_importance.png", p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_behavioural_importance.png\n\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

vsurf_output <- list(
  vsurf_object = vsurf_result,
  selected_vars = selected_vars,
  vsurf_threshold = vsurf_threshold,
  vsurf_interpretation = vsurf_interpretation,
  vsurf_prediction = vsurf_prediction,
  importance_df = importance_df,
  comb_summary = if(exists("comb_summary")) comb_summary else data.frame(),
  metadata = list(
    outcome = outcome_var,
    n_obs = nrow(X),
    n_input = ncol(X),
    n_selected = length(selected_vars),
    time_minutes = time_taken
  )
)

saveRDS(vsurf_output, "VSURF_behavioural_results.rds")
saveRDS(selected_vars, "VSURF_behavioural_selected.rds")

cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_behavioural_results.rds\n")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_behavioural_selected.rds\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11C COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("FINAL SELECTION:\n")
cat("  Variables selected:", length(selected_vars), "\n")
cat("  Sample size:", nrow(X), "\n")
cat("  Events per variable:", round(outcome_table[2] / length(selected_vars), 1), "\n\n")

cat("SELECTED BEHAVIOURAL VARIABLES:\n")
for(i in seq_along(selected_vars)) {
  cat("  ", i, ". ", selected_vars[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

cat("✓ Ready for logistic regression modeling\n\n")
```

## DEM VSURF
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# VSURF ANALYSIS: DEMOGRAPHICS
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Identify which demographic variables are essential confounders
# Rationale: Reduce predictor count to improve EPV
# Strategy: Let VSURF decide which demographics truly predict outcome
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(VSURF)
library(mice)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VSURF ANALYSIS: DEMOGRAPHIC VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART A: LOAD DATA
#==============================================================================

# Load imputed data
if(!file.exists("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run Chunk 9 first")
}

mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded imputed data with", mids_data$m, "imputations\n\n")

# Get outcome variable
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

#==============================================================================
# PART B: DEFINE DEMOGRAPHIC VARIABLES
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DEFINING DEMOGRAPHIC VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Define all available demographics
demographics_all <- c("age", "sex", "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq")

cat("DEMOGRAPHIC VARIABLES (", length(demographics_all), "):\n\n", sep = "")
cat("  Continuous (1): age\n")
cat("  Categorical (5): sex, education, income, employment, driving_freq\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART C: PREPARE DATA
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PREPARING DATA\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Extract first imputation (consistent with personality chunk)
data_complete <- complete(mids_data, 1)

# Check variable availability
available_vars <- demographics_all[demographics_all %in% names(data_complete)]
missing_vars   <- demographics_all[!demographics_all %in% names(data_complete)]

if(length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  WARNING: Missing variables:\n")
  for(var in missing_vars) cat("    •", var, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}

cat("Available demographic variables:", length(available_vars), "of", length(demographics_all), "\n\n")

# Prepare predictor matrix
X <- data_complete %>%
  select(all_of(available_vars)) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

cat("Variable types:\n")
for(var in names(X)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %s\n", var, class(X[[var]])))
}
cat("\n")

# Prepare outcome
if(!outcome_var %in% names(data_complete)) {
  stop("ERROR: Outcome variable '", outcome_var, "' not found!")
}

y <- data_complete[[outcome_var]]

# Remove missing outcomes
complete_idx <- !is.na(y)
X <- X[complete_idx, ]
y <- y[complete_idx]
y <- factor(y, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Continued", "Discontinued"))
y <- droplevels(y)

cat("Data for VSURF:\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(X), "\n")
cat("  Predictors:", ncol(X), "\n")
cat("  Outcome:", outcome_var, "\n\n")

cat("Outcome distribution:\n")
outcome_table <- table(y)
print(outcome_table)
cat("\n  Discontinuation rate:", round(100 * outcome_table[2] / sum(outcome_table), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Events per variable:", round(outcome_table[2] / ncol(X), 1), "\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART D: RUN VSURF
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("RUNNING VSURF\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("VSURF Algorithm:\n")
cat("  1. THRESHOLDING - Remove irrelevant variables\n")
cat("  2. INTERPRETATION - Variables for explanatory models\n")
cat("  3. PREDICTION - Minimal set for pure prediction\n\n")

cat("VSURF settings:\n")
cat("  Variables:", ncol(X), "demographics\n")
cat("  Trees: 2000\n")
cat("  mtry:", max(floor(ncol(X)/3), 1), "\n\n")

cat("Running VSURF (this may take 1-2 minutes)...\n\n")

set.seed(123)
start_time <- Sys.time()

vsurf_result <- tryCatch({
  VSURF(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    ntree = 2000,
    mtry = max(floor(ncol(X)/3), 1),
    parallel = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("\n✗ ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
  return(NULL)
})

end_time   <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 2)

cat("\n✓ VSURF completed in", time_taken, "minutes\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART E: EXTRACT RESULTS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VSURF RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(is.null(vsurf_result)) {
  # Fallback: Standard RF importance
  cat("⚠️  VSURF failed - using fallback (RF importance)\n\n")

  set.seed(123)
  rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)

  importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    Variable   = names(importance_vals),
    Importance = importance_vals
  ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

  # Select top variables (cap at half of input)
  n_select       <- min(ceiling(ncol(X) / 2), nrow(importance_df))
  selected_vars  <- importance_df$Variable[1:n_select]

  vsurf_threshold    <- selected_vars
  vsurf_interpretation <- selected_vars
  vsurf_prediction   <- selected_vars[1:min(3, length(selected_vars))]

} else {
  # Extract VSURF results
  vsurf_threshold      <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.thres]
  vsurf_interpretation <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.interp]
  vsurf_prediction     <- names(X)[vsurf_result$varselect.pred]

  # Get importance
  if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable   = vsurf_threshold,
      Importance = vsurf_result$imp.varselect.thres
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  } else {
    set.seed(123)
    rf_model <- randomForest(x = X, y = y, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)
    importance_vals <- importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
    importance_df <- data.frame(
      Variable   = names(importance_vals),
      Importance = importance_vals
    ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  }

  selected_vars <- vsurf_interpretation
}

# Display results
cat("STEP 1 - THRESHOLDING:", length(vsurf_threshold), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_threshold) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_threshold)) cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_threshold[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 2 - INTERPRETATION:", length(vsurf_interpretation), "variables\n")
cat("→ USE THESE FOR EXPLANATORY MODEL\n")
if(length(vsurf_interpretation) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_interpretation)) cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_interpretation[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

cat("STEP 3 - PREDICTION:", length(vsurf_prediction), "variables\n")
if(length(vsurf_prediction) > 0) {
  for(i in seq_along(vsurf_prediction)) cat("  ", i, ". ", vsurf_prediction[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

cat("VARIABLE IMPORTANCE:\n")
print(importance_df, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART F: RECOMMENDATION
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: RECOMMENDATIONS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(length(selected_vars) == 0) {
  recommendation <- "MINIMAL ADJUSTMENT"
  selected_vars  <- c("age", "sex")  # Default epidemiological confounders
  rationale <- "VSURF found no demographics strongly predictive. Including age and sex\nas standard epidemiological confounders."
} else if(length(selected_vars) <= 2) {
  recommendation <- "PARSIMONIOUS ADJUSTMENT"
  rationale <- sprintf("VSURF selected %d demographic(s). Use these for confounder adjustment.",
                       length(selected_vars))
} else {
  recommendation <- "MODERATE ADJUSTMENT"
  rationale <- sprintf("VSURF selected %d demographics. This maintains balance between\nconfounding control and EPV preservation.",
                       length(selected_vars))
}

cat("RECOMMENDED APPROACH:", recommendation, "\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

cat("Demographics to include in regression models:\n")
for(v in selected_vars) cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", v))
cat("\n")

cat("Rationale:\n")
cat(rationale, "\n\n")

# EPV calculation
n_events <- sum(y == "Discontinued")
cat("EPV CALCULATION:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("Events: %d\n", n_events))
cat(sprintf("VSURF demographics selected: %d\n", length(selected_vars)))

# Load personality VSURF results if available
if(file.exists("VSURF_personality_results.rds")) {
  vsurf_pers <- readRDS("VSURF_personality_results.rds")
  n_pers     <- length(vsurf_pers$selected_vars)
  cat(sprintf("VSURF personality selected: %d\n\n", n_pers))

  cat("Model configurations:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  Personality only:           %d predictors, EPV = %.1f\n",
              n_pers, n_events / n_pers))
  cat(sprintf("  Personality + Demographics: %d predictors, EPV = %.1f\n",
              n_pers + length(selected_vars),
              n_events / (n_pers + length(selected_vars))))
  cat(sprintf("  Minimal (E+M+demo):         %d predictors, EPV = %.1f\n",
              2 + length(selected_vars),
              n_events / (2 + length(selected_vars))))
} else {
  cat("  (VSURF_personality_results.rds not found - skipping EPV model comparison)\n")
}
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART G: VISUALIZATION
#==============================================================================

cat("Creating visualization...\n")

if(nrow(importance_df) > 0) {
  plot_data <- importance_df %>%
    mutate(Selected = Variable %in% selected_vars)

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance),
                              y = Importance,
                              fill = Selected)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#4DAF4A", "FALSE" = "#BDBDBD"),
                      name = "VSURF Selected") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title    = "Variable Importance - Demographic Predictors",
      subtitle = paste("VSURF selected", length(selected_vars), "of", ncol(X), "variables"),
      x        = NULL,
      y        = "Variable Importance (Mean Decrease Gini)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  ggsave("VSURF_demographics_importance.png", p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_demographics_importance.png\n\n")
}

#==============================================================================
# PART H: SAVE RESULTS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART H: SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

vsurf_output <- list(
  vsurf_object         = vsurf_result,
  selected_vars        = selected_vars,
  vsurf_threshold      = vsurf_threshold,
  vsurf_interpretation = vsurf_interpretation,
  vsurf_prediction     = vsurf_prediction,
  importance_df        = importance_df,
  metadata = list(
    outcome      = outcome_var,
    n_obs        = nrow(X),
    n_input      = ncol(X),
    n_selected   = length(selected_vars),
    time_minutes = time_taken
  )
)

saveRDS(vsurf_output, "VSURF_demographics_results.rds")
saveRDS(selected_vars, "VSURF_demographics_selected.rds")

cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_demographics_results.rds\n")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_demographics_selected.rds\n\n")

# Eliminated variables
vars_eliminated <- setdiff(names(X), selected_vars)

# Summary report
report <- c(
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
  "VSURF DEMOGRAPHICS - SUMMARY REPORT",
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
  "",
  sprintf("Total demographics tested: %d", ncol(X)),
  sprintf("Variables selected (interpretation): %d", length(selected_vars)),
  sprintf("Variables eliminated: %d", length(vars_eliminated)),
  "",
  "SELECTED DEMOGRAPHICS:",
  paste("  •", selected_vars, collapse = "\n"),
  "",
  "ELIMINATED DEMOGRAPHICS:",
  if(length(vars_eliminated) > 0) paste("  •", vars_eliminated, collapse = "\n") else "  (None)",
  "",
  "RECOMMENDATION:",
  paste(" ", recommendation),
  "",
  rationale,
  "",
  "NEXT STEPS:",
  "  1. Use selected demographics in regression models",
  "  2. This improves EPV while controlling key confounders",
  "",
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
)

writeLines(report, "VSURF_demographics_report.txt")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_demographics_report.txt\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# SUMMARY
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VSURF DEMOGRAPHICS COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("FINAL SELECTION:\n")
cat("  Variables selected:", length(selected_vars), "\n")
cat("  Sample size:", nrow(X), "\n")
cat("  Events per variable:", round(outcome_table[2] / length(selected_vars), 1), "\n\n")

cat("SELECTED DEMOGRAPHIC VARIABLES:\n")
for(i in seq_along(selected_vars)) {
  cat("  ", i, ". ", selected_vars[i], "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")

for(line in report) cat(line, "\n")

cat("\n✓ Proceed to revised regression models using selected demographics\n\n")
```



## LR
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# FINAL REVISED REGRESSION: 4 OPTIMIZED MODELS
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Build parsimonious models with optimal EPV using VSURF Prediction
# Changes from previous version:
#   - Model 3 now uses VSURF PREDICTION set (4 vars)
#   - Model 4 is VSURF Prediction + Demographics
#   - Clearer alignment with VSURF methodology
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(pROC)
library(broom)
library(car)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FINAL REVISED REGRESSION (4 OPTIMIZED MODELS)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART A: LOAD DATA AND VSURF RESULTS
#==============================================================================

cat("PART A: Loading data and VSURF results\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Load imputed data (mids object - consistent with VSURF chunks)
if(!file.exists("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run Chunk 9 first to create imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
}

mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed data with %d imputations\n", mids_data$m))

# Build imputed list from mids object for pooling
imputed_list <- lapply(1:mids_data$m, function(i) complete(mids_data, i))
cat(sprintf("✓ Extracted %d complete datasets\n", length(imputed_list)))

# Load VSURF personality results
# List structure: selected_vars, vsurf_threshold, vsurf_interpretation,
#                 vsurf_prediction, importance_df, metadata
if(!file.exists("VSURF_personality_results.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run Chunk 11A first to create VSURF_personality_results.rds")
}
vsurf_pers <- readRDS("VSURF_personality_results.rds")

# Load VSURF demographics results
# List structure: selected_vars, vsurf_threshold, vsurf_interpretation,
#                 vsurf_prediction, importance_df, metadata
if(!file.exists("VSURF_demographics_results.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run demographics VSURF chunk first to create VSURF_demographics_results.rds")
}
vsurf_demo <- readRDS("VSURF_demographics_results.rds")

cat("\nVSURF-selected variables:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Personality - Interpretation: %d variables\n", length(vsurf_pers$vsurf_interpretation)))
cat(sprintf("  Personality - Prediction:     %d variables\n", length(vsurf_pers$vsurf_prediction)))
cat(sprintf("  Demographics - Selected:      %d variables\n", length(vsurf_demo$selected_vars)))

# Define outcome
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"
n_events    <- sum(imputed_list[[1]][[outcome_var]], na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("\nEvents: %d\n\n", n_events))

#==============================================================================
# PART B: DEFINE VARIABLE SETS
#==============================================================================

cat("PART B: Defining variable sets\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# VSURF-selected personality (Interpretation set - Step 2)
personality_interpretation <- vsurf_pers$vsurf_interpretation

# VSURF-selected personality (Prediction set - Step 3)
personality_prediction <- vsurf_pers$vsurf_prediction

# VSURF-selected demographics
demographics_vsurf <- vsurf_demo$selected_vars

# Guard against empty prediction set - fall back to interpretation
if(length(personality_prediction) == 0) {
  cat("WARNING: VSURF prediction set is empty - falling back to interpretation set\n\n")
  personality_prediction <- personality_interpretation
}

cat(sprintf("PERSONALITY - INTERPRETATION SET (%d variables):\n", length(personality_interpretation)))
for(v in personality_interpretation) cat(sprintf("  * %s\n", v))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("PERSONALITY - PREDICTION SET (%d variables) - VSURF STEP 3:\n", length(personality_prediction)))
for(v in personality_prediction) cat(sprintf("  * %s\n", v))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("DEMOGRAPHICS (%d variables, VSURF-selected):\n", length(demographics_vsurf)))
for(v in demographics_vsurf) cat(sprintf("  * %s\n", v))
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART C: DEFINE 4 MODELS
#==============================================================================

cat("PART C: Defining 4 models\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Model 1: VSURF Interpretation (all selected personality variables)
vars_m1    <- personality_interpretation
formula_m1 <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(vars_m1, collapse = " + ")))
epv_m1     <- n_events / length(vars_m1)

# Model 2: VSURF Interpretation + Demographics (fully adjusted)
vars_m2    <- c(personality_interpretation, demographics_vsurf)
formula_m2 <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(vars_m2, collapse = " + ")))
epv_m2     <- n_events / length(vars_m2)

# Model 3: VSURF Prediction (optimal data-driven model)
vars_m3    <- personality_prediction
formula_m3 <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(vars_m3, collapse = " + ")))
epv_m3     <- n_events / length(vars_m3)

# Model 4: VSURF Prediction + Demographics (adjusted optimal model)
vars_m4    <- c(personality_prediction, demographics_vsurf)
formula_m4 <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(vars_m4, collapse = " + ")))
epv_m4     <- n_events / length(vars_m4)

cat("MODEL SPECIFICATIONS:\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Model 1: VSURF Interpretation\n")
cat(sprintf("  Predictors: %d\n", length(vars_m1)))
cat(sprintf("  Variables: %s\n", paste(vars_m1, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("  EPV: %.1f\n\n", epv_m1))

cat("Model 2: VSURF Interpretation + Demographics\n")
cat(sprintf("  Predictors: %d\n", length(vars_m2)))
cat(sprintf("  Variables: %s\n", paste(vars_m2, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("  EPV: %.1f\n\n", epv_m2))

cat("Model 3: VSURF Prediction - PRIMARY (DATA-DRIVEN)\n")
cat(sprintf("  Predictors: %d\n", length(vars_m3)))
cat(sprintf("  Variables: %s\n", paste(vars_m3, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("  EPV: %.1f (OPTIMAL)\n\n", epv_m3))

cat("Model 4: VSURF Prediction + Demographics\n")
cat(sprintf("  Predictors: %d\n", length(vars_m4)))
cat(sprintf("  Variables: %s\n", paste(vars_m4, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("  EPV: %.1f\n\n", epv_m4))

cat("EPV ASSESSMENT:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
for(i in 1:4) {
  epv    <- c(epv_m1, epv_m2, epv_m3, epv_m4)[i]
  status <- ifelse(epv >= 10, "Adequate (>=10)",
                   ifelse(epv >= 5, "Borderline (5-10)", "Low (<5)"))
  cat(sprintf("  Model %d: EPV = %4.1f  %s\n", i, epv, status))
}
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART D: FIT MODELS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: FITTING MODELS ACROSS IMPUTATIONS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

fit_pooled_model <- function(imputed_list, formula_obj, model_name) {
  cat(sprintf("Fitting %s...\n", model_name))

  m    <- length(imputed_list)
  fits <- vector("list", m)

  for(i in 1:m) {
    fits[[i]] <- glm(formula_obj, data = imputed_list[[i]], family = binomial())
  }

  fit_mira <- structure(fits, class = c("mira", "matrix"))
  pooled   <- pool(fit_mira)

  cat(sprintf("  Done: %s\n", model_name))
  return(list(fit = fit_mira, pooled = pooled))
}

model1 <- fit_pooled_model(imputed_list, formula_m1, "Model 1")
model2 <- fit_pooled_model(imputed_list, formula_m2, "Model 2")
model3 <- fit_pooled_model(imputed_list, formula_m3, "Model 3")
model4 <- fit_pooled_model(imputed_list, formula_m4, "Model 4")

cat("\nAll models fitted\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART E: EXTRACT SUMMARIES
#==============================================================================

cat("PART E: Extracting summaries\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

get_summary <- function(pooled_obj, model_name) {
  summary(pooled_obj, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      OR       = exp(estimate),
      OR_lower = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
      OR_upper = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error),
      OR_CI    = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
      sig = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p.value < 0.10  ~ ".",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      ),
      model = model_name
    ) %>%
    select(model, term, estimate, std.error, OR, OR_lower, OR_upper, OR_CI,
           statistic, p.value, sig)
}

summary_m1 <- get_summary(model1$pooled, "Model 1")
summary_m2 <- get_summary(model2$pooled, "Model 2")
summary_m3 <- get_summary(model3$pooled, "Model 3")
summary_m4 <- get_summary(model4$pooled, "Model 4")

all_summaries <- bind_rows(summary_m1, summary_m2, summary_m3, summary_m4)

cat("Summaries extracted\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART F: CALCULATE AUC
#==============================================================================

cat("PART F: Calculating AUC\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

calc_auc <- function(fit_mira, imputed_list, boot.n = 2000) {

  m      <- length(imputed_list)
  aucs   <- numeric(m)
  lowers <- numeric(m)
  uppers <- numeric(m)

  for(i in 1:m) {

    pred_i <- predict(fit_mira[[i]], type = "response")
    roc_i  <- roc(imputed_list[[i]][[outcome_var]], pred_i, quiet = TRUE)

    aucs[i] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_i))

    # BOOTSTRAP CI
    ci_i <- ci.auc(roc_i, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = boot.n)

    lowers[i] <- ci_i[1]
    uppers[i] <- ci_i[3]
  }

  data.frame(
    AUC_mean  = mean(aucs),
    AUC_lower = mean(lowers),
    AUC_upper = mean(uppers)
  )
}

auc_m1 <- calc_auc(model1$fit, imputed_list)
auc_m2 <- calc_auc(model2$fit, imputed_list)
auc_m3 <- calc_auc(model3$fit, imputed_list)
auc_m4 <- calc_auc(model4$fit, imputed_list)

cat("AUC calculated\n\n")

  Model        = c("Model 1", "Model 2", "Model 3", "Model 4"),
  Description  = c("VSURF Interpretation",
                   "VSURF Interpretation + Demo",

  EPV          = c(epv_m1, epv_m2, epv_m3, epv_m4),
  AUC          = c(auc_m1$AUC_mean, auc_m2$AUC_mean, auc_m3$AUC_mean, auc_m4$AUC_mean),
  AUC_Lower    = c(auc_m1$AUC_lower, auc_m2$AUC_lower, auc_m3$AUC_lower, auc_m4$AUC_lower),
  AUC_Upper    = c(auc_m1$AUC_upper, auc_m2$AUC_upper, auc_m3$AUC_upper, auc_m4$AUC_upper)
) %>%
  mutate(
    AUC_formatted = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", AUC, AUC_Lower, AUC_Upper),
    EPV_status    = ifelse(EPV >= 10, "Adequate",
                           ifelse(EPV >= 5, "Borderline", "Low"))
  )

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

print_results <- function(summary_df, model_name, desc, auc_stats) {
  cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat(model_name, ":", desc, "\n")
  cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("AUC: %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]\n\n",
              auc_stats$AUC_mean, auc_stats$AUC_lower, auc_stats$AUC_upper))

  sig <- summary_df %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)", p.value < 0.05) %>%
    select(term, OR_CI, p.value, sig)

  if(nrow(sig) > 0) {
    cat("Significant Predictors (p < .05):\n")
    print(sig, row.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("No significant predictors (p < .05)\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

print_results(summary_m1, "MODEL 1", "VSURF Interpretation",       auc_m1)
print_results(summary_m2, "MODEL 2", "VSURF Interpretation + Demo", auc_m2)
print_results(summary_m3, "MODEL 3", "VSURF Prediction - PRIMARY",  auc_m3)

consistency_check <- personality_prediction %>%
  map_df(function(pred) {
    m3_row <- summary_m3 %>% filter(term == pred)
    m4_row <- summary_m4 %>% filter(term == pred)

    tibble(
      Predictor = pred,
      M3_OR  = if(nrow(m3_row) > 0) m3_row$OR      else NA_real_,

      M4_OR  = if(nrow(m4_row) > 0) m4_row$OR      else NA_real_,

      M4_sig = if(nrow(m4_row) > 0) m4_row$sig      else ""
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        Consistent_sig = (M3_p < 0.05) & (M4_p < 0.05),
        OR_change_pct  = 100 * (M4_OR - M3_OR) / M3_OR
      )
  })
```

## Cross-Validation
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CROSS-VALIDATION ON IMPUTED DATA (REVISED FOR NEW MODELS)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Internal validation using 10-fold CV across all imputations
# Why imputed data: Complete cases (75.8%) may be biased; imputed data
#                   reflects full sample and our actual analysis approach
# Method: Perform CV on each imputation, then pool results
# Updated: Now uses Model 3 (VSURF Prediction) as primary model
# AUC CIs: Bootstrap method (boot.n = 2000), averaged across imputations
#           to match final_regression_results_revised approach
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(pROC)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CROSS-VALIDATION: IMPUTED DATA\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART A: LOAD DATA AND MODEL
#==============================================================================

cat("PART A: Loading data\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Load imputed data (mids object - consistent with VSURF and regression chunks)
if(!file.exists("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run Chunk 9 first to create imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
}

mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed data with %d imputations\n", mids_data$m))

# Build imputed list from mids object
imputed_list <- lapply(1:mids_data$m, function(i) complete(mids_data, i))
cat(sprintf("✓ Extracted %d complete datasets\n", length(imputed_list)))

# Load final regression results (REVISED VERSION)
if(!file.exists("final_regression_results_revised.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run final regression chunk first to create final_regression_results_revised.rds")
}

final_results <- readRDS("final_regression_results_revised.rds")

# Use Model 3 (VSURF Prediction - PRIMARY)
model_vars  <- final_results$variables$model3
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

cat(sprintf("\nModel: Model 3 (VSURF Prediction - PRIMARY)\n"))
cat(sprintf("Predictors: %s\n", paste(model_vars, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Imputations: %d\n", length(imputed_list)))
cat(sprintf("Sample size: %d per imputation\n\n", nrow(imputed_list[[1]])))

#==============================================================================
# PART B: CALCULATE APPARENT PERFORMANCE
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: APPARENT PERFORMANCE (NO CV)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

formula_obj <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(model_vars, collapse = " + ")))

# Bootstrap CI settings (used for CV AUC only)
boot.n <- 2000

# Pull apparent AUC directly from saved regression results (Model 3)
# This guarantees exact match with regression chunk - no seed coordination needed
perf_m3 <- final_results$performance %>% filter(Model == "Model 3")

apparent_auc_mean  <- perf_m3$AUC
apparent_auc_lower <- perf_m3$AUC_Lower
apparent_auc_upper <- perf_m3$AUC_Upper

# Refit per imputation for range/SD diagnostics only (no CI resampling)
apparent_aucs <- numeric(length(imputed_list))
for(imp in 1:length(imputed_list)) {
  data_imp  <- imputed_list[[imp]]
  model_imp <- glm(formula_obj, data = data_imp, family = binomial())
  pred_imp  <- predict(model_imp, type = "response")
  roc_imp   <- roc(data_imp[[outcome_var]], pred_imp, quiet = TRUE)
  apparent_aucs[imp] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_imp))
}

cat("Apparent performance (from final_regression_results_revised.rds - Model 3):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("Mean AUC: %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]\n",
            apparent_auc_mean, apparent_auc_lower, apparent_auc_upper))
cat("Note: CIs are identical to regression chunk (same saved object, no resampling)\n")
cat(sprintf("Range across imputations: %.4f to %.4f\n", min(apparent_aucs), max(apparent_aucs)))
cat(sprintf("SD across imputations:    %.4f\n", sd(apparent_aucs)))
cat("AUC per imputation: "); cat(sprintf("%.4f", apparent_aucs), sep = "  "); cat("\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART C: 10-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION ON EACH IMPUTATION
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: 10-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Settings:\n")
cat("  Method: 10-fold CV\n")
cat("  Repetitions: Performed on each imputation separately\n")
cat("  Pooling: Average across imputations\n")
cat(sprintf("  Bootstrap CI: boot.n = %d (consistent with regression chunk)\n\n", boot.n))

cv_one_imputation <- function(data, formula_obj, outcome_var, n_folds = 10, seed = 123, boot.n = 2000) {

  set.seed(seed)
  n        <- nrow(data)
  fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = n))

  fold_aucs <- numeric(n_folds)
  all_preds <- numeric(n)
  all_obs   <- numeric(n)

  for(k in 1:n_folds) {
    train_data <- data[fold_ids != k, ]
    test_data  <- data[fold_ids == k, ]

    model_k <- glm(formula_obj, data = train_data, family = binomial())
    pred_k  <- predict(model_k, newdata = test_data, type = "response")

    all_preds[fold_ids == k] <- pred_k
    all_obs[fold_ids == k]   <- test_data[[outcome_var]]

    roc_k        <- roc(test_data[[outcome_var]], pred_k, quiet = TRUE)
    fold_aucs[k] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_k))
  }

  # Overall CV AUC from concatenated out-of-fold predictions
  roc_overall <- roc(all_obs, all_preds, quiet = TRUE)
  overall_auc <- as.numeric(auc(roc_overall))

  # Bootstrap CI on overall CV AUC - seed offset to be distinct from apparent CI seed
  set.seed(seed + 1000)
  ci_overall <- ci.auc(roc_overall, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = boot.n)

  list(
    overall_auc   = overall_auc,
    cv_lower      = ci_overall[1],
    cv_upper      = ci_overall[3],
    fold_aucs     = fold_aucs,
    mean_fold_auc = mean(fold_aucs),
    sd_fold_auc   = sd(fold_aucs)
  )
}

cat("Running cross-validation on each imputation...\n")

cv_results_list <- vector("list", length(imputed_list))

for(m in 1:length(imputed_list)) {
  cat(sprintf("  Imputation %d/%d...\r", m, length(imputed_list)))
  cv_results_list[[m]] <- cv_one_imputation(
    data        = imputed_list[[m]],
    formula_obj = formula_obj,
    outcome_var = outcome_var,
    n_folds     = 10,
    seed        = 123 + m,
    boot.n      = boot.n
  )
}

cat("\nCross-validation complete\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART D: POOL CV RESULTS ACROSS IMPUTATIONS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: POOLED CV RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Pool point estimates and CIs by averaging across imputations
# (consistent with calc_auc() pooling approach in regression chunk)
cv_aucs   <- sapply(cv_results_list, function(x) x$overall_auc)
cv_lowers <- sapply(cv_results_list, function(x) x$cv_lower)
cv_uppers <- sapply(cv_results_list, function(x) x$cv_upper)

cv_auc_mean  <- mean(cv_aucs)
cv_auc_lower <- mean(cv_lowers)
cv_auc_upper <- mean(cv_uppers)

cat("Cross-validated performance:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("Mean CV AUC: %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]\n",
            cv_auc_mean, cv_auc_lower, cv_auc_upper))
cat(sprintf("Range across imputations: %.4f to %.4f\n", min(cv_aucs), max(cv_aucs)))
cat(sprintf("SD across imputations:    %.4f\n", sd(cv_aucs)))
cat("AUC per imputation: "); cat(sprintf("%.4f", cv_aucs), sep = "  "); cat("\n\n")

optimism_mean <- apparent_auc_mean - cv_auc_mean

cat("Optimism (Apparent - CV):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

#==============================================================================

#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: FOLD-LEVEL STABILITY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

  Mean_AUC = numeric(10),

)

for(k in 1:10) {

  fold_summary$Mean_AUC[k] <- mean(fold_aucs_k)

}

cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

            min(fold_summary$Mean_AUC), max(fold_summary$Mean_AUC)))

  recommendation <- "Report apparent AUC with note of CV validation. Model is robust."

  detail         <- "Model shows acceptable generalizability. Some optimism present but\nwithin normal range for sample size."
  recommendation <- "Report both apparent and CV AUC. Use CV estimate for external\nvalidation planning."
} else {
  interpretation <- "SUBSTANTIAL optimism (>0.05)"
  detail         <- "Model shows concerning overfitting. Apparent performance significantly\noverestimates true discrimination."
  recommendation <- "Report CV AUC as primary estimate. Consider further model simplification.\nExternal validation critical."
}

#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART G: SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

performance_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Apparent AUC", "CV AUC", "Optimism"),
  Value  = c(apparent_auc_mean, cv_auc_mean, optimism_mean),
  Lower  = c(apparent_auc_lower, cv_auc_lower, NA),
  Upper  = c(apparent_auc_upper, cv_auc_upper, NA),
  Formatted = c(

    sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", cv_auc_mean, cv_auc_lower, cv_auc_upper),

  )
)

cv_details <- tibble(
```

## Firth Regression
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# FIRTH PENALIZED LOGISTIC REGRESSION - VSURF PREDICTION MODEL
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Address influential cases and potential separation issues
# Problem: Influential cases = quasi-separation risk
# Solution: Firth's penalized likelihood reduces bias in finite samples
# Interpretation: Yields shrunken (conservative) estimates
# Updated: Now tests all 4 VSURF Prediction variables
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(logistf)  # Firth regression
library(pROC)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FIRTH PENALIZED LOGISTIC REGRESSION - VSURF PREDICTION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART A: LOAD DATA AND IDENTIFY PROBLEM
#==============================================================================

cat("PART A: Understanding the problem\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Load imputed data (mids object - consistent with VSURF and regression chunks)
if(!file.exists("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run Chunk 9 first to create imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
}

mids_data <- readRDS("imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed data with %d imputations\n", mids_data$m))

# Build imputed list from mids object
imputed_list <- lapply(1:mids_data$m, function(i) complete(mids_data, i))
cat(sprintf("✓ Extracted %d complete datasets\n", length(imputed_list)))

# Load final model specification (REVISED)
if(!file.exists("final_regression_results_revised.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Run final regression chunk first to create final_regression_results_revised.rds")
}

final_results <- readRDS("final_regression_results_revised.rds")
model_vars  <- final_results$variables$model3  # VSURF Prediction
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

cat(sprintf("\nModel: Model 3 (VSURF Prediction)\n"))
cat(sprintf("Predictors: %s\n\n", paste(model_vars, collapse = ", ")))

cat("THE PROBLEM (from influential cases analysis):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("* Influential cases identified (Cook's D > threshold)\n")
cat("* Most influential cases discontinued medication (~86%)\n")
cat("* This raised concern about potential separation:\n")
cat("  - Standard ML estimates become unstable/biased\n")
cat("  - Coefficients artificially inflated\n\n")

cat("THE SOLUTION: Firth's Penalized Likelihood\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("* Adds penalty term to likelihood function\n")
cat("* Reduces finite-sample bias\n")
cat("* Handles separation gracefully\n")
cat("* Yields conservative (shrunken) estimates\n")
cat("* Widely used for small samples and rare events\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART B: FIT FIRTH MODELS ACROSS IMPUTATIONS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: FITTING FIRTH MODELS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Fitting Firth regression on each imputation...\n")

formula_obj <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(model_vars, collapse = " + ")))

firth_models <- vector("list", length(imputed_list))
firth_coefs  <- vector("list", length(imputed_list))

for(m in 1:length(imputed_list)) {
  cat(sprintf("  Imputation %d/%d...\r", m, length(imputed_list)))

  firth_m <- logistf(formula_obj, data = imputed_list[[m]], pl = TRUE)

  firth_models[[m]] <- firth_m

  firth_coefs[[m]] <- data.frame(
    term     = names(coef(firth_m)),
    estimate = coef(firth_m),
    se       = sqrt(diag(vcov(firth_m))),
    ci_lower = firth_m$ci.lower,
    ci_upper = firth_m$ci.upper,
    p_value  = firth_m$prob
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      OR       = exp(estimate),
      OR_lower = exp(ci_lower),
      OR_upper = exp(ci_upper)
    )
}

cat("\nFirth models fitted\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART C: POOL FIRTH ESTIMATES (RUBIN'S RULES)
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: POOLING ESTIMATES ACROSS IMPUTATIONS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

all_terms <- unique(firth_coefs[[1]]$term)

pooled_firth <- tibble(
  term     = all_terms,
  estimate = numeric(length(all_terms)),
  OR       = numeric(length(all_terms)),
  OR_lower = numeric(length(all_terms)),
  OR_upper = numeric(length(all_terms)),
  p_value  = numeric(length(all_terms))
)

for(i in seq_along(all_terms)) {
  term_i <- all_terms[i]

  estimates_i <- sapply(firth_coefs, function(x) x$estimate[x$term == term_i])
  ses_i       <- sapply(firth_coefs, function(x) x$se[x$term == term_i])

  Q_bar <- mean(estimates_i)
  U_bar <- mean(ses_i^2)
  B     <- var(estimates_i)
  T     <- U_bar + (1 + 1/length(imputed_list)) * B

  se_pooled <- sqrt(T)
  z_stat    <- Q_bar / se_pooled

  pooled_firth$estimate[i] <- Q_bar
  pooled_firth$OR[i]       <- exp(Q_bar)
  pooled_firth$OR_lower[i] <- exp(Q_bar - 1.96 * se_pooled)
  pooled_firth$OR_upper[i] <- exp(Q_bar + 1.96 * se_pooled)
  pooled_firth$p_value[i]  <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_stat))
}

pooled_firth <- pooled_firth %>%
  mutate(
    sig   = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ ""
    ),
    OR_CI = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper)
  ) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")

cat("Pooled Firth estimates:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
print(pooled_firth %>% select(term, OR_CI, p_value, sig))
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART D: COMPARE FIRTH VS STANDARD LOGISTIC
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: FIRTH VS STANDARD LOGISTIC COMPARISON\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

standard_results <- final_results$summaries$model3 %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  select(term, Standard_OR = OR, Standard_p = p.value) %>%
  mutate(Standard_OR_formatted = sprintf("%.2f", Standard_OR))

comparison <- full_join(
  pooled_firth %>% select(term, Firth_OR = OR, Firth_p = p_value, Firth_OR_CI = OR_CI),
  standard_results,
  by = "term"
) %>%
  mutate(
    OR_diff_pct = 100 * (Firth_OR - Standard_OR) / Standard_OR,
    Direction   = case_when(
      abs(OR_diff_pct) < 5  ~ "Similar",
      OR_diff_pct > 0       ~ "Firth larger",
      OR_diff_pct < 0       ~ "Firth smaller"
    ),
    Sig_change  = case_when(
      Firth_p < 0.05 & Standard_p >= 0.05 ~ "Gained sig",
      Firth_p >= 0.05 & Standard_p < 0.05 ~ "Lost sig",
      TRUE                                 ~ "Consistent"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(OR_diff_pct)))

cat("Coefficient comparison:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
print(comparison %>% select(term, Standard_OR_formatted, Firth_OR_CI, OR_diff_pct, Sig_change))
cat("\n")

mean_change <- mean(abs(comparison$OR_diff_pct), na.rm = TRUE)
max_change  <- max(abs(comparison$OR_diff_pct), na.rm = TRUE)
n_sig_changes <- sum(comparison$Sig_change != "Consistent", na.rm = TRUE)

cat("SUMMARY:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("Max OR change:  %.1f%%\n", max_change))
cat(sprintf("Mean OR change: %.1f%%\n", mean_change))
cat(sprintf("Significance changes: %d predictor(s)\n\n", n_sig_changes))

#==============================================================================
# PART E: ALL VSURF PREDICTORS FOCUS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: ALL VSURF PREDICTION VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

for(i in 1:nrow(comparison)) {
  row <- comparison[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%s:\n", row$term))
  cat(sprintf("  Standard:  OR = %.2f, p = %.4f %s\n",
              row$Standard_OR, row$Standard_p,
              ifelse(row$Standard_p < 0.05, "*", "")))
  cat(sprintf("  Firth:     OR = %s, p = %.4f %s\n",
              row$Firth_OR_CI, row$Firth_p,
              ifelse(row$Firth_p < 0.05, "*", "")))
  cat(sprintf("  Change:    %+.1f%% (%s)\n", row$OR_diff_pct, row$Direction))
  cat(sprintf("  Status:    %s\n\n", row$Sig_change))
}

#==============================================================================
# PART F: MODEL PERFORMANCE
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: MODEL PERFORMANCE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

firth_aucs <- numeric(length(imputed_list))

for(m in 1:length(imputed_list)) {
  pred_m      <- predict(firth_models[[m]], type = "response")
  roc_m       <- roc(imputed_list[[m]][[outcome_var]], pred_m, quiet = TRUE)
  firth_aucs[m] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_m))
}

firth_auc_mean <- mean(firth_aucs)
firth_auc_sd   <- sd(firth_aucs)

standard_auc <- final_results$performance %>%
  filter(Model == "Model 3") %>%
  pull(AUC)

cat("AUC Comparison:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("Standard logistic: %.3f\n", standard_auc))
cat(sprintf("Firth penalized:   %.3f (SD: %.3f)\n", firth_auc_mean, firth_auc_sd))
cat(sprintf("Difference:        %.3f\n\n", firth_auc_mean - standard_auc))

#==============================================================================
# PART G: INTERPRETATION & RECOMMENDATION
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART G: INTERPRETATION & RECOMMENDATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(mean_change < 10 & n_sig_changes == 0) {
  interpretation <- "MINIMAL DIFFERENCES"
  detail         <- "Firth and standard logistic yield very similar estimates. The\npenalization has minimal impact, suggesting separation is not severe."
  recommendation <- "Report standard logistic as primary analysis. Mention Firth as\nsensitivity check showing robustness."
} else if(mean_change < 20 & n_sig_changes <= 1) {
  interpretation <- "MODERATE SHRINKAGE"
  detail         <- "Firth yields moderately different estimates. Some shrinkage toward\nnull, as expected with penalization."
  recommendation <- "Report both analyses. Firth estimates may be more conservative\nand appropriate given influential cases."
} else {
  interpretation <- "SUBSTANTIAL DIFFERENCES"
  detail         <- "Firth substantially differs from standard logistic. This suggests\nstandard ML may be unreliable due to separation."
  recommendation <- "Prioritize Firth estimates. Standard logistic may be biased.\nDiscuss separation issue in methods/limitations."
}

cat(interpretation, "\n\n")
cat(detail, "\n\n")

cat("RECOMMENDATION:\n")
cat(recommendation, "\n\n")

cat("FOR MANUSCRIPT:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("Suggested text for methods:\n\n")
cat('  "Given the presence of influential cases (all discontinued medication),\n')
cat('   we performed sensitivity analysis using Firth\'s penalized logistic\n')
cat('   regression to address potential quasi-separation. Firth regression\n')
cat('   reduces bias in finite samples and yields more conservative estimates\n')
cat('   when separation is present."\n\n')

cat("Suggested text for results:\n\n")
if(n_sig_changes == 0) {
  cat(sprintf('  "All VSURF-selected predictors were robust to Firth penalized\n'))
  cat(sprintf('   regression (mean OR change: %.1f%%, all significant predictors\n', mean_change))
  cat('   remained significant)."\n\n')
} else {
  cat(sprintf('  "VSURF-selected predictors showed variable robustness to Firth\n'))
  cat(sprintf('   penalization (mean OR change: %.1f%%, %d predictor(s) changed\n',
              mean_change, n_sig_changes))
  cat('   significance status). [Detail which changed]"\n\n')
}

#==============================================================================
# PART H: SAVE RESULTS
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART H: SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

report <- c(
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
  "FIRTH PENALIZED LOGISTIC REGRESSION - SUMMARY (VSURF)",
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
  "",
  "MODEL: Model 3 (VSURF Prediction)",
  sprintf("Predictors: %s", paste(model_vars, collapse = ", ")),
  "",
  "PURPOSE:",
  "  Address quasi-separation from influential cases",
  "",
  "METHOD:",
  "  Firth's penalized likelihood (reduces finite-sample bias)",
  "",
  "RESULTS:",
  sprintf("  Mean OR change: %.1f%%", mean_change),
  sprintf("  Max OR change:  %.1f%%", max_change),
  sprintf("  Significance changes: %d predictor(s)", n_sig_changes),
  sprintf("  AUC (Firth):    %.3f", firth_auc_mean),
  sprintf("  AUC (Standard): %.3f", standard_auc),
  "",
  "ALL VSURF PREDICTORS:",
  paste(capture.output(
    print(comparison %>% select(term, Standard_OR_formatted, Firth_OR_CI, OR_diff_pct, Sig_change))
  ), collapse = "\n"),

  detail,

  "RECOMMENDATION:",

  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
)

write_csv(pooled_firth,  "firth_pooled_estimates_vsurf.csv")
write_csv(comparison,    "firth_vs_standard_comparison_vsurf.csv")
saveRDS(firth_models,    "firth_models_all_imputations_vsurf.rds")
```
